Nature Dragon
items.description: The Nature Dragon loves humans, animals and all living things - some of them for gastronomic purposes. Even though it hasn't eaten a whole human, a finger or two have been lost...

items.name: Firebird Dragon
items.description: Like a phoenix - the symbol of rebirth - this dragon is said to be immortal. Its fire feathers and regal flight are an impressive sight. It is said that this birds' cry is that of a beautiful song.

items.name: Mercury Dragon
items.description: This dragon is highly unpredictable, poisonous and has an exceptionally low melting point. But when the sun shines from the right angle, this liquid creature looks absolutely magnificent!

items.name: Gummy Dragon
items.description: Bouncy and happy, you will have a new best friend in this dragon! The Gummy Dragon loves butterflies, sugar and summer clouds.

items.name: Lantern Fish Dragon
items.description: This mythical dragon from the deepest oceans is an absolutely hilarious companion. The Lantern Fish Dragon can light up the darkest, stormiest night with its witty anecdotes from life underwater.

items.name: Tropical Dragon
items.description: The Tropical Dragon likes to dance all night, do acrobatics and enjoy life in general. Its happy-go-lucky attitude is very catchy, so in its company it is impossible not to smile!

items.name: Zombie Dragon
items.description: This undead dragon has a huge appetite! It keeps eating, but somehow nothing seems to fill it up. Despite its constant hunger, forgetful nature and bad vision, it has proven to be loyal.

items.name: Petroleum Dragon
items.description: A dragon with the worst attitude. It can look extremely dirty at first but it's actually a very clean character. Petroleum Dragons like sunshine and sandy beaches. They despise the cold.

items.name: Dandelion Dragon
items.description: This feather-light friend is a must for every dragon enthusiast. Its puffy appearance will draw crowds from far, far away to see its famous disappearing act.

items.name: Jade Dragon
items.description: The Jade Dragon is the wisest of them all. Ask him any question or present him any problem and you will receive an answer from this ancient being. Now you'll just have to learn Chinese to understand him.

items.name: Star Dragon
items.description: Who doesn't like looking at stars on a clear night? This Dragon is made of stars and during the nights you can see it shine. The Star Dragon is one of the most calm and happy dragons, a friend to all.

items.name: Terra Dragon
items.description: Don't be alarmed, it's not an earthquake but a dignified Terra Dragon! Terra Dragons are not known for their beauty, but for their love for dirt and their extremely humble and honest nature.

items.name: Flaming Rock Dragon
items.description: What happens when you set earth on fire? This Dragon is one of the most energetic ones around. Flaming Rock especially loves rock music and Dragon Chili snacks.

items.name: Armadillo Dragon
items.description: Armadillo is an easily angered dragon, so be very careful when around it. It wears heavy protective gear, but what lies under all that armor and anger? Go find out!

items.name: Cloud Dragon
items.description: Many people don't even know that they have seen this dragon because it blends perfectly into the sky. If you feel like the rain is following you sometimes, here you have the explanation!

items.name: Laser Dragon
items.description: This futuristic dragon is a delightful addition to your islands. It's highly energetic and likes to fry small insects with its laser beams. This means you can also have bug control on your islands!

items.name: Mud Dragon
items.description: They're sometimes mistakenly described as chubby or lazy, but we happen to know that Mud Dragons are on a strict organic mud diet and they only enjoy an occasional fly when it happens to land directly on their mouth.

items.name: Nenufar Dragon
items.description: Fantastically beautiful, this dragon always draws crowds wherever it goes. Have you seen those floating flowers move on a pond? Maybe it wasn't a flower after all...

items.name: Hedgehog Dragon
items.description: This dragon is extremely fond of people, but unfortunately its spiky exterior is not exactly human-friendly. Wear some armor and go play!

items.name: Icecube Dragon
items.description: Is it getting hot in your island? The Icecube Dragon is just the creature to cool things down. Calm, cool as ice and quite slow. this sympathetic fellow is no threat at all.

items.name: Flame Dragon
items.description: If you can't take the heat, stay away from the Flame Dragon! This temperamental creature is easily set off, but calms down equally fast and always feels deep remorse for the things it burned.

items.name: Neon Dragon
items.description: If you think neon colors were a thing of the 80's, you are wrong! The neon colors are back. This dragon is pure sunshine on wings!

items.name: Pearl Dragon
items.description: The Pearl Dragon is known to be a bit vain and often wastes considerable amounts of time shining its pearls. When necessary, it can be extremely brave and selfless and will help anyone in need.

items.name: Cool Fire Dragon
items.description: If you thought northern lights are incredible, wait 'till you see this dragon fly around! It's both as cool as ice and as hot as fire and it will never get tired of huffing and puffing.

items.name: Medieval Dragon
items.description: The Medieval Dragon hails from the times of King Arthur, who gave him the precious task of protecting his sword. Ever since, he has been looking for a new master. Could it be you?

items.name: Penguin Dragon
items.description: At first sight, it's easy to mistake this dragon for a penguin, but don't be fooled as its teeth are extremely sharp!

items.name: Ice Dragon
items.description: With the recent climate changes, the super cool Ice Dragons have migrated to the North Pole. If you see one in a warm place, please direct them to the nearest ice rink and you'll have a friend forever.

items.name: Carnivorous Plant Dragon
items.description: This cheerful meat eater is almost blind but has an extraordinarily keen sense of smell. It can smell anything from miles away, so don't ever think that you can surprise this dragon however hard you try.

items.name: Fluorescent Dragon
items.description: This one glows in the dark, so it's highly convenient during the dark winter months. You will also save on electricity by getting this glowy dragon!

items.name: Electric Dragon
items.description: The tale tells us this dragon was born in a great storm that took place in the dark ages, when an ordinary dragon got hit by lightning. Since that day, you can see other dragons in the skies looking for a shock.

items.name: Battery Dragon
items.description: Running out of batteries all the time? This dragon will be your new best friend and you will always be charged with energy when around it!

items.name: Sea Dragon
items.description: If you're into water sports, then the Sea Dragon will be your new best friend. Often, Sea Dragons have been mistaken for seals or dolphins.

items.name: Metal Dragon
items.description: A robust dragon, drawn towards all things of metal. The word on the island is that what the Metal Dragon lacks in intellect, it more than makes up in determination.

items.name: Dark Dragon
items.description: The Dark Dragon is highly elusive; only a handful of eye witnesses have managed to spot this creature of the night. Because of its color and nocturnal rhythm, it's virtually impossible to see!

items.name: Legacy Dragon
items.description: This dragon is so legendary that no words can do it justice. Be aware though: your life will never be the same again after encountering this creature made of legends.

items.name: Vampire Dragon
items.description: When you have caught the Vampire Dragon, you can truly congratulate yourself. Beware though, it can't be tamed so treat it nicely or it will just fly away!

items.name: Alpine Dragon
items.description: Alpine Dragon, the robust cousin of Ice Dragon is impossible not to love! This adorable creature is irresistibly playful and friendly. Watch out for avalanches though!

items.name: Poo Dragon
items.description: Sometimes it is considered slightly disgusting, but in some parts of the world, poo is thought to bring good luck and fortune! Are you brave enough to put this dragon on your island?

items.name: Volcano Dragon
items.description: This is the most explosive cousin of the Alpine Dragon. Always happy and cheerful, watch out though, it's hot!

items.name: Blizzard Dragon
items.description: Weirdly enough this dragon made of snow and ice seems to like hot and wet environments! To see this rare dragon flap around in a pile of lava is definitely worth the effort!

items.name: Rattlesnake Dragon
items.description: Potentially deadly, this dragon has to be treated with care to stop it from biting its master! When fully trained, it can be the most loyal servant.

items.name: Gold Dragon
items.description: Precious by nature, this dragon is the most giving of them all. If you take good care and feed it well, it might just lay a beautiful golden egg.

items.name: Soccer Dragon
items.description: The ancestors of this dragon happened to make a home at a soccer stadium and that's how it all started. The dragons began watching games and finally learned how to play themselves.

items.name: Platinum Dragon
items.description: A dragon of this magnitude certainly knows its worth. Platinum Dragon is generally known as the leader of the pack and isn't afraid to demonstrate its power.

items.name: Pirate Dragon
items.description: A-hoy dragon lovers! This very special dragon will be a crown jewel in your dragon collection. Get ready for some reckless sea adventures and hop on board!

items.name: Crystal Dragon
items.description: If you like shiny, valuable things, you will like the Crystal Dragon. It is very rare and only shows itself when the planets are appropriately aligned. You'll be lucky to see it! Breed Pure dragons to get Legend ones.

items.name: Air Dragon
items.description: Famous for its flying skills, this dragon can float for hours and hours without even moving a wing. It's a master of the currents and some witnesses say that it changes color according to the weather! Breed Pure dragons to get Legend ones.

items.name: Mirror Dragon
items.description: Do you like admiring yourself in the mirror? Then the Mirror Dragon will be your new best friend! Some people say that you can catch a glimpse of the future reflected in this dragon. Breed Pure dragons to get Legend ones.

items.name: Coral Dragon
items.description: The Coral Dragon reflects that which is most beautiful underwater. The colorful gardens of the abyss are more magnificent than you could ever imagine. This dragon is a treasure!

items.name: Spicy Dragon
items.description: Spice up your island kingdom with this temperamental fellow. The Spicy Dragon is known for its excessive use of swear words and a passion for Mexican food.

items.name: Waterfall Dragon
items.description: This dragon is an absolute wonder! Where does the water come from and where is it going? Who knows! It's still mesmerizing to watch.

items.name: Cactus Dragon
items.description: The Cactus Dragon loves to cuddle, what a shame that it is covered with spikes. If you're charmed by it despite the stings, put your gloves on and give it a hug!

items.name: Storm Dragon
items.description: This dragon loves stormy weather more than anything! If you feel that life is getting too peaceful in your island kingdom, get the Storm Dragon to shake things up.

items.name: Ice Cream Dragon
items.description: This dragon is so delicious that it's actually on the verge of extinction; greedy children everywhere tend to have a taste! Please restrain yourself and admire it from a distance.

items.name: Mojito Dragon
items.description: You know that it's summer when you see mojitos everywhere! Invite this refreshing dragon to your islands and we can guarantee that the party will never stop.

items.name: Chameleon Dragon
items.description: A master of camouflage - the Chameleon Dragon actually changes color, so don't be alarmed if it seems to have disappeared, just wait a sec and it'll appear again! Fun fact: this dragon sees everything.

items.name: Hot Metal Dragon
items.description: The Hot Metal Dragon is impressive - turn the temperature up and watch it ignite! This dragon comes from the core of the earth, where its ancestors still live and breed.

items.name: Snowflake Dragon
items.description: This beautiful dragon is very friendly and delicate, always baring snowflakes - nature's own works of art. Just keep the temperature low or it'll melt!

items.name: Seashell Dragon
items.description: Who doesn't love seashells - the treasures of the sea? Offer this dragon a home and see what beautiful, shiny treasures will come out!

items.name: Moose Dragon
items.description: Did you know that the Moose Dragon is one of the most ancient animals around today? In the beginning of times in the ancient marshes, a moose and a dragon met... It was love at first sight and the result is delightful!

items.name: Dragonfly Dragon
items.description: Sometimes a dragon is even closer than you think - just sitting on the rock behind you or flying by when you're laying on the grass. Despite often being mistaken for an insect, the Dragonfly is all Dragon.

items.name: Venom Dragon
items.description: Rising from deep underground, comes the impressive Venom Dragon. It's potentially lethal but it can also provide an antidote when you need it most. Will you take the risk?

items.name: Steampunk Dragon
items.description: A masterpiece of classic machinery, this one actually came to life with a little help from our Dragon Master, Deus. Keep it well oiled and you will have a loyal servant forever!

items.name: Dark Fire Dragon
items.description: From the darkest of caves rises a sombre character. The temperature of the purple flames on its back are unbearable to any other living thing. Whatever you do, don't show your fear.

items.name: Butterfly Dragon
items.description: Release this magical dragon onto your island and enjoy its mesmerizing beauty! You will never be able to catch it, but given its firey temper, maybe this dragon is best appreciated from afar.

items.name: Robot Dragon
items.description: Have you ever imagined you'd have a robot servant in the future? Well, the future is already here and this Robot Dragon is the best servant you could ever have! It even has a container for cold drinks.

items.name: Pure Terra Dragon
items.description: Tougher, stonier and edgier, the Pure Terra Dragon is an impressive sight. It enjoys mountain climbing, rock crushing and pretty much all temperatures!

items.name: Pure Flame Dragon
items.description: This more mature dragon of the Flame element is like royalty! As full of fire and character as the basic Flame Dragon, but with twice the readiness and wisdom.

items.name: Pure Sea Dragon
items.description: Even more watery than you could have ever imagined, Pure Sea Dragon is also pure fun. Like a dolphin, it's always ready to play but also very intelligent by nature.

items.name: Pure Nature Dragon
items.description: Like a flower that's just bloomed, this dragon is a pure, natural delight for the eyes. Everyone is always charmed by its beautiful energy and mesmerizing scent.

items.name: Pure Electric Dragon
items.description: Electricity is strongly present in this dragon. If you touch it, you won't get electrocuted but cleansed and highly charged! With the Pure Electric you'll have a lot of energy for years to come.

items.name: Pure Ice Dragon
items.description: Ice, Ice Baby! If you're not afraid of the cold then step into the Kingdom of Pure Ice where the temperature is so cold that ice turns into crystals. It's cold, shiny and beautiful here!

items.name: Pure Metal Dragon
items.description: This highly evolved Pure Metal Dragon consists of a mix of metals still unknown to man. It's incredibly durable and can take any heat without melting.

items.name: Pure Dark Dragon
items.description: The darkness has now doubled! Two evil brains to plot some dark plans and four observing eyes to see even better in the twilight zone.

items.name: Pure Dragon
items.description: Can you imagine a creature so pure that it almost makes you blind with the light of its purity? Our earthly words fail to do the Pure Dragon justice, so you'd better experience it in person!

items.name: Paladin Dragon
items.description: The Paladin is a dragon made of epic adventures, noble deeds and magical powers. It's one of the most well-behaved dragons of all time, but has a peculiar weakness for hot dogs!

items.name: Fossil Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use level 15 or higher dragons The unique quality of the Fossil Dragon is that it can be trapped in ice for centuries and yet fly away as agile as an eagle when the ice melts. This dragon has a lot of stories to tell.

items.name: Seahorse Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use level 10 or higher dragons This happy-go-lucky dragon adores the beach life and the sun! You can find it at all major surfing spots around the world, splashing in the waves and bringing smiles to the faces of all creatures.

items.name: Sky Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use level 10 or higher dragons This dragon is as mysterious as it gets! It's a whisper in the air, a light September breeze on your cheek, a slight shadow disappearing before your eyes... Catch it if you can!

items.name: Bat Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use level 15 or higher dragons Deriving from bats, this dragon has many special talents. It is an amazingly agile flyer and can eat up to 1000 orcs per hour. Adopt it to keep your neighborhood clean!

items.name: Aztec Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use level 15 or higher dragons Coming from deep in the jungle, where its mysterious civilization has dwelled undisturbed for millennia, this rare dragon’s wisdom is sought after by sages far and wide.

items.name: Chinese Dragon
items.description: This dragon has always been close to the Emperor of China and some even say that it might be the true holder of the imperial power. It brings you good luck, prosperity and wisdom.

items.name: King Dragon
items.description: Contrary to popular belief, the King Dragon often leaves the throne and mingles with low-birth dragons, willing to share the joys of life away from wealth, if only for a while.

items.name: Wizard Dragon
items.description: Most would think that combining a wizard and a dragon would result in pure magical power. Unfortunately, this dragon is mostly known for its clumsiness and an utterly strange sense of humor.

items.name: Two-Headed Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons level 15 or higher Two is definitely better than one! This two-headed beast is double the fun and double the trouble! Please don't turn your back on it unless you want to end up as the target of a practical joke.

items.name: Plankton Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use level 10 or higher dragons Comfortable both under and above water, this dragon is known as the 'wanderer' - able to travel thousands of miles without rest. With its magnificent glow, it's especially impressive at night.

items.name: Uncle Sam Dragon
items.description: This dragon is all stars, stripes and bangles and it wants YOU to enjoy Dragon City with your friends! He's very sporty, social and has always been the most popular dragon on the island.

items.name: Evil Pumpkin Dragon
items.description: Carved pumpkins are cute, but watch out for this one - it's pure evil in an orange package! It'll steal your candy and egg your car before you have time to say "Boo!"

items.name: Viking Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use level 15 or higher dragons Watch out for this Nordic dragon, as it'll do everything possible to conquer and pillage the habitats of other dragons... unless it decides to enjoy a lengthy meal and then sleep instead!

items.name: Jelly Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use level 15 or higher dragons Wobbly and cheerful, this dragon is a blast! It has a special ability to change color when it grows up and it makes people of all ages laugh hysterically!

items.name: Quetzal Dragon
items.description: Dating back to the Mesoamerican jungles, this dragon is a boundary maker between heaven and earth. Moving fast to the skies and back, Quetzal is also the high priest of all dragons!

items.name: Queen Dragon
items.description: The prettier counterpart of the power couple -Their Majesties King and Queen Dragon- is known for her peaceful and fair nature. Only the tricks of the evil witch will awake her dark fury!

items.name: Thanksgiving Dragon
items.description: This dragon is one of the first habitants of the magical Dragon Islands! It's known for its humble and grateful nature and has an incredible fondness towards oven-cooked turkey!

items.name: Santa Dragon
items.description: Ho ho ho! The merriest dragon ever wishes you an awesome Christmas! With him all the days of the year are filled with peace and sharing.

items.name: Ghost Dragon
items.description: Are you ready to be haunted? This ghastly dragon possesses a slightly split personality, so you will never know if it's evil or good when you play with it.

items.name: Deep Forest Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 15 or higher This dragon comes from the depths of forests that were old when mankind was young, the herald of an age long forgotten. Be respectful, as this dragon is the guardian of all forest creatures.

items.name: Ninja Dragon
items.description: Keep your eyes on this dragon at all times since, despite its cute look, it's extremely dangerous and crafty! Turn around and you just might have a ninja star in your back.

items.name: Ice&Fire Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 15 or higher This creature of extreme controversy is very hard to capture! Its life is a constant migration from the equator to the Antarctic to keep both sides satisfied.

items.name: Aurora Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 15 or higher This dragon is even harder to spot than the Northern Lights themselves, so not much is known about its nature. Just get ready for the most amazing show that this planet has to offer!

items.name: Music Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 10 or higher Can your hear that mesmerizing sound coming from above? It's the Music Dragon, creating the most beautiful sounds with its wings while flying through the clouds of Dragon Islands.

items.name: Block Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 15 or higher What happens when plastic, electricity and dark forces combine? A Block Dragon is created - the dragon with a great sense of humor and an infinite collection of slightly naughty jokes!

items.name: Summerfly Dragon
items.description: Release this magical dragon into you islands and enjoy its mesmerizing beauty! You will never be able to catch it but you can enjoy its fiery temper from afar.

items.name: Alien Dragon
items.description: A dragon from another universe - a completely unknown alien entity! Don't even try to fool this creature, as it can read your mind before you even think your thoughts!

items.name: Great White Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 10 or higher This dragon is legendary even amongst the Legendary Dragons. Its regal stature attracts attention wherever it flies. It prefers colder climates due to the risk of sunburn.

items.name: Pharaoh Dragon
items.description: When the sun sets behind the ancient pyramids, some statues start to move... This ruler dragon can hold his pose for centuries before taking a tour under cover of night.

items.name: Paradise Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 10 or higher What happens when you put a dragon in paradise? It grows bright, light feathers, starts to glow like gold and is filled with eternal peace and tranquility unlike any other dragon known.

items.name: Gaudi Dragon
items.description: This dragon is legendary even amongst the legendary dragons. Its regal stature attracts attention wherever it flies. It prefers colder climates due to the risk of sunburn.

items.name: Cool Fire Dragon
items.description: If you thought the Northern Lights were incredible, wait 'till you see this dragon fly around! It's both as cool as ice and as hot as fire, and never gets tired of huffing and puffing.

items.name: Octopus Dragon
items.description: This dragon is the boss of all the pirates and can fight up to 8 opponents at the same time with its evil tentacles! Beat it and you can be very proud of your achievement.

items.name: Jellyfish Dragon
items.description: Sometimes the most beautiful thing can be the most harmful one. Looking at the Jellyfish Dragon might feel like a mesmerizing dream, until you get too close...

items.name: Carnival Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use level 15 or higher dragons There's no party like a Carnival Dragon party! Wherever this dragon travels, the party starts immediately. If you can't handle the fun, stay out of the way!

items.name: Love Dragon
items.description: Will love unite us or tear us apart? For those searching for answers to the big questions, getting to know this endearing dragon is highly recommended! All you need is Love Dragon.

items.name: Dujur Dragon
items.description: Despite its size, Dujur is as light as a spring cloud and hence does not need wings for flying. Dujur brings good luck with it wherever it flies and never gets tired of helping children!

items.name: T-Rex Dragon
items.description: The T-Rex Dragon greatly resembles one of the most dangerous hunters ever. Something changed along the way though since this specimen is one of the most harmless dragons around.

items.name: Brontosaurus Dragon
items.description: This vegetarian giant loves all living creatures: children, animals, dragons... But most of all it loves all plants suitable for eating! In fact there are rumors that 'bronto' means 'forever hungry'.

items.name: Hydra Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 15 or higher The legend tells that when you cut one of Hydra Dragon's heads off, two more will grow in its place. So you'd better keep this dragon and its poisonous breath on your side!

items.name: Mars Dragon
items.description: Get ready for some serious X-Files action with this stranger-than-fiction dragon. Remember to feed it with plenty of space plasma and dragon food to keep baby dragons from disappearing.

items.name: Prisma Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 15 or higher What really happens at the end of a rainbow? From the reflections of the shiny treasures, a Prisma Dragon is born with all the colors of the universe on its back.

items.name: Centipede Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 20 or higher This dragon is one of the fastest ones...on land! It can break dance like a pro but in the air it often gets tangled up in its own feet and wings and completely loses control.

items.name: Emerald Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 20 or higher Not all that shines is gold... Some of it is emerald! This extremely precious dragon is one of the most valuable ones in Dragon Islands. Guard it to make sure it doesn't get stolen.

items.name: St Patrick's Dragon
items.description: On St. Patrick's Day, everyone is Irish! And being Irish on this day means a non-stop celebration with green colors. Befriend this buddy if you want to party all year long!

items.name: Ruby Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 20 or higher If you want to capture the light of a million sunsets, the glimmer of a thousand lakes and the heat of the hottest fires, get the Ruby Dragon and visitors will flock to your islands!

items.name: Angry Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 20 or higher Don´t make this dragon get angry! It may look a little bit absent-minded and cute, but there are secret powers hidden in its mutant blood.

items.name: Lava Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 20 or higher For millions of years, this super mighty dragon has been sleeping in the deepest cracks of the mountains. Now it's time to unleash its power!

items.name: Joker Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 15 or higher Time to laugh! This very rare dragon loves pranks and tricks. If you give him the chance, you'll find a sticker on your back saying “kick me!”

items.name: Chainmail Dragon
items.description: This unique armored dragon will be one of the most precious pieces in your collection. As powerful as Armadillo, and as stunning as Platinum, the Chainmail Dragon is a magical masterpiece.

items.name: Sphynx Dragon
items.description: Ra blessed this magical creature a gazillion years ago. Mysteries and mystical powers are hidden in the pyramids guarded by the Sphynx Dragon.

items.name: Mummy Dragon
items.description: Many think that the Mummy Dragon was formerly a Zombie Dragon with some concerns about his look, but that´s not true. The Mummy Dragon was long ago a king among kings, and now he´s back...

items.name: Diamond Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use dragons that are level 20 or higher Star dust, the most solid rock in the universe and Deus' magical touch made this dragon come alive. Rumors say that not even the Emerald and Ruby Dragons combined could defeat this new juggernaut.

items.name: Demon Dragon
items.description: The realm of dragons has its own mystical side. It is said that the Demon Dragon appears in the nightmares of other dragons.

items.name: Gargoyle Dragon
items.description: Daylight turns him into a stone statue, but at night he awakens! Look closely at the black sky and you might find him roaming the darkness above you.

items.name: Deep Red Dragon
items.description: In the depths of the biggest and most active volcanoes sleeps the Deep Red Dragon. Once in a while, when an eruption happens, the world can see its real power.

items.name: Blue Dragon
items.description: Deep in the sea and close to the volcanic faults, the Blue Dragon emerged centuries ago as the King of the depths. Are you bold enough to tame him?

items.name: Archangel Dragon
items.description: Deus himself created the Archangel Dragon when he was a brave young god. When he needs something done, he chooses the Archangel Dragon for the job.

items.name: Lightning Dragon
items.description: Have you ever heard the quote "There's always a calm before the storm"? It is said that this quote refers to the Lightning Dragon.

items.name: Ancient Dragon
items.description: For eons, there was nothing but time and.... the Ancient Dragon! Even if this sounds kind of boring, this gives the Ancient Dragon a unique perspective about basically everything.

items.name: Wurm Dragon
items.description: Be careful what you wish for, there is always a chance that the Wurm Dragon will appear and accomplish it. But maybe not exactly as you thought.

items.name: Glacial Dragon
items.description: His razor-sharp edges turn the Glacial Dragon’s whole body into a dangerous weapon! In winter, he retreats back to the polar regions to regenerate his powers.

items.name: Cerberus Dragon
items.description: Also known as The Guardian, the Cerberus Dragon protects the dungeons and the treasures inside them. He has a lot of spare time while he is standing guard and fills this time playing Rock 'n' Roll.

items.name: Burning Dragon
items.description: The fire inside Burning Dragons is not your usual fire. It's a magical, dark fire with the power to consume anything in seconds, much quicker than usual and of course way more dangerous.

items.name: Treasure Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: use level 15 or higher dragons Jewels, gold, magic crystals, diamonds… the Treasure Dragon hoards the riches of his defeated enemies in his lair. Only a dragon master can control the Treasure Dragon. Is that you?

items.name: Granite Dragon
items.description: It is said that the Granite Dragon combines the three hardest rock types on Earth. Let's not get into the scientific details, but this just means it is three times tougher.

items.name: Bone Dragon
items.description: This soulless dragon comes from the Northern Lands, far beyond The Wall. He is controlled by the dark magic that Darkus created millennia ago, and with his dead body he can attack opponents with unnatural power.

items.name: Wyvern Dragon
items.description: Deus sends the Angel Demon as his agent when he needs something. He is obeys his master and he uses his powers for good, usually.

items.name: Predator Dragon
items.description: This dragon loves herbivores, especially to eat them. Be careful! When he's hungry he begins to devour any living thing slower than him. Except kittens.

items.name: Poseidon Dragon
items.description: Poseidon is usually quite calm and sleepy in the ocean. If he gets angry however, he starts producing tsunamies and earthquakes. Fun fact: He hates eating fish.

items.name: Hades Dragon
items.description: The realm of the underworld is controlled by Hades. His favorite part of the job is his friendship with the sea of souls.

items.name: Atlas Dragon
items.description: Atlas is usually exhausted from carrying the globe with him wherever he goes. That duty has shaped his body, resulting in a powerful dragon that is capable of performing the most impressive attacks!

items.name: Justice Dragon
items.description: If you feel an injustice happened, just call the Justice Dragon. His balance will decide what’s fair... and his sword will decide what’s not.

items.name: Sun Dragon
items.description: The Sun Dragon lives inside the solar corona. When there's a sun storm, you can see it dancing with the flares, just like a child splashing in a swimming pool.

items.name: Mater Natura Dragon
items.description: The Gaia Dragon is like a mother to all plant dragons. It has a gentle nature until it gets angry, just like all mothers.

items.name: Luminescent Dragon
items.description: Deep under the sea where the Luminescent Dragon lives it can get pretty dark! It survives this total darkness by providing its own light, which it uses for hunting and disco parties - two totally related things.

items.name: Rainbow Dragon
items.description: This dragon takes white light and turns it into the whole light spectrum, coating itself with all the colors you can see - and probably some that you can't!

items.name: War Dragon
items.description: Every empire in history has feared the huge War Dragon. It destroys everything in its path, including buildings, bridges, other dragons... and its enemies' morale.

items.name: Juggernaut Dragon
items.description: The Juggernaut Dragon has been in every possible battle since the beginning of time, and it still wants more! Each scratch on its body corresponds to a dragon defeated in battle. Or they may come from its pet kitten!

items.name: Colossal Dragon
items.description: It is hard not to be impressed by the size of this dragon. From far away it looks big. As it gets closer it becomes huge. And when you see it close up, it's totally colossal.

items.name: Red Woods Dragon
items.description: The Red Woods contain the tallest trees and the tallest dragons. They are made of millenary wood, making them extremely resistant but prone to boredom - especially when they yawn for an entire month.

items.name: Leviathan Dragon
items.description: This epic creature has inhabited the seas for eons, devouring entire civilizations as a snack. Do you dare to go deep and discover the treasures it hides?

items.name: Panzer Dragon
items.description: For years the Panzer Dragons were sent to the front lines during the epic dragon fights of the Second Age. Most of them are retired and like long walks and longer naps. But they still have the fighting spirit in them.

items.name: Nirobi Dragon
items.description: Master of doom and darkness. Lord of all things creepy. His LinkedIn profile is totally impressive if you're looking for an expert in the dark side of things. Breed Pure dragons to get Legend ones.

items.name: Droconos Dragon
items.description: Time is relative, everybody knows that. What most people don't know is that Droconos plays with time like a child plays with a ball. Déjà-vus are his favourite jokes. Breed Pure dragons to get the Legend ones.

items.name: Monstrous Dragon
items.description: This classy monster comes from another dimension, a world full of Monster Legends! He crossed space and time to join the Dragon City inhabitants, where he feels really welcome.

items.name: Ivory Dragon
items.description: This majestic creature is the envy of all dragons. Its skin is shiny, white ivory with filigrees of gold. It's as if an artist made a beautiful dragon sculpture which came to life!

items.name: Moon Dragon
items.description: Have you ever seen a full moon? It happens once every twenty eight days. That is the exact sleep cycle of the Moon Dragon, who wakes up really angry and goes back to bed.

items.name: Toxic Dragon
items.description: Be careful! It's toxic! This dragon has some strange eating habits. He loves to have some sulfur for breakfast and radioactive remains for lunch, although he is on a diet now so he only gets a couple of old batteries for dinner.

items.name: Obsidian Dragon
items.description: After a volcano errupts, obsidian is the material that remains! Hard and cutting, this dragon is pure power! Every single edge he has is a deadly knife!

items.name: Meteor Dragon
items.description: Millenia ago, the Meteor Dragon got in a fight with the Brontosaurus Dragon. He flew up in the sky and hit the earth at a high speed, causing the extinction of all the dinosaurs on the earth.

items.name: Hammer Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use level 15 or higher dragons. Do you know why this dragon is called Hammer Dragon? Some people think it is because it looks like the hammerhead shark, but actually it just likes to hit things with its metal head - mainly other dragons.

items.name: Tribal Dragon
items.description: Ukma akma atmu utma, entu entu aku aku!!! This is actually the war cry of the Tribal Dragon, which means "attack!"

items.name: Origami Dragon
items.description: When Deus was a child, he liked the art of Origami. One day he created a beautiful paper dragon and he blew life into it. Since then, the Origami Dragon can be seen floating on thermal air currents high in the sky.

items.name: Tiny Dragon
items.description: Breeding hint: Use level 15 or higher dragons Even in adulthood, this dragon remains tiny. For this reason, this little dragon appeals to many girls! But don't be fooled, despite its small size, this dragon is a seriously tough opponent.

items.name: Night Wind Dragon
items.description: In the darkest nights the Nightwind Dragon howls to the sky like a wolf. Your heart will freeze if you hear him!

items.name: Thor Dragon
items.description: Thor is known for his mastery of war, along with his beloved six pack. He's loved battle for as long as he can remember and makes every fight a competition with his brother, Loki.

items.name: Loki Dragon
items.description: Loki has always been a clever and sharp warrior. With his deadly, dark skills he's able to defeat most of his enemies. There is only one thing he lacks that prevents him from being the perfect warrior: his brother's hammer!

items.name: Odin Dragon
items.description: Deus and Odin often hang out together. When they do, they talk about exciting topics such as the weather or newborn dragons. When they get extremely bored by that stuff, they start dragon wars. Watching the fight together, they will bet on their best champions.

items.name: Fallen Angel Dragon
items.description: The Northern Myths tell us that this dragon was punished by Deus, who took away his angel status and condemned him to a life on Earth. But within two days he was having lots of fun in this new land, hanging out with the Visigoths.

items.name: Cold Star Dragon
items.description: Born in cold outer space, this dragon's diet consists of White Dwarf stars and tomatoes, which is why he travels from galaxy to galaxy. The Cold Star Dragon is the most spaced out of them all.

items.name: Photon Dragon
items.description: This quantic dragon is the guardian of all electromagnetic forces! As it consists of pure light, it can travel at the speed of light and all the colors of the light spectrum originate from it.

items.name: Elfic Dragon
items.description: Since the first time the elves walked over Arda, this dragon has been protecting them all.  His armor is made of leather strips, iron ingot and refined moonstones. He is immune to all the forces of evil.

items.name: Zen Dragon
items.description: Six arms! Two to stand up on the ground in homage to the First Noble Truth, “all life is suffering.” Two for meditation, “to avoid craving and aversion.” And two more to follow the Noble Eightfold Path and develop compassion for others.

items.name: Tesla Dragon
items.description: The Master of War and Electricity. The Lord of the Bolts and Strikes. The Commander of Energy and Conflict. And the Father of Modern Battle Science. His résumé is fairly impressive.

items.name: Kratus Dragon
items.description: Full of rage and anger, Kratus is the last of his kind. He is known as the Dragon of War. Feared, respected and also admired by all, no one dares to face him in battle.

items.name: Saturn Dragon
items.description: There is no doubt that the Saturn Dragon comes from outer space. The beauty of his wings can hypnotize you if you look at them for more than one second! Finding one of these celestial dragons on Earth is a rather rare occurrence!

items.name: Dark Stone Dragon
items.description: Like volcanic rock, he's extra lightweight meaning he is able to fly with those small wings at high speed. Those thick arms and horns may look dangerous, but due to his porousness his punches are harmless.

items.name: White Knight Dragon
items.description: The White Knight Dragon was created with love and light magic. His pureness makes him a beloved dragon, always protecting the good and justice from the Black Knight Dragon, who insists in fighting him again and again and again...

items.name: Black Knight Dragon
items.description: The Black Knight Dragon was created from hate and black magic. His warrior abilities are famous, as it is his sword "Stormbroker". For some reasson, his only fate in life is to fight the White Knight Dragon, again and again and again...

items.name: Thief Dragon
items.description: Everyone is innocent until proven guilty, except the Thief Dragon! He gets everything he wants using tricks and traps, so do not turn your back on him! However, if it's gold that you want, this is your dragon.

items.name: Deus Pet Dragon
items.description: Everybody knows Deus loves dragons! But as it happens, he has a particular favorite. His chosen one is Deus Pet Dragon; probably because it is one of the cutest dragons ever created.

items.name: Midas Dragon
items.description: He conceded the Golden Touch to King Midas, who could transform everything into gold and became the richest king ever. However, that blessing became a curse when he accidentally transformed his own son into gold. Get this dragon and swim in oceans of gold!

items.name: Mysterious Dragon
items.description: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? Oh wait... it's nothing because Kryptonite Dragon has just eaten it! Attention, superheroes of the world, Kryptonite Dragon has arrived!

items.name: Aquamarine Dragon
items.description: This dragon likes to live near water. He gets his name from his color, a shade of transparent green and blue. He likes to camouflage himself in the water when he is hunting fish. Aquamarine is a very agile and graceful dragon!

items.name: Blue Fire Dragon
items.description: Some kids dream of strange creatures while sleeping. That’s the case for Blue Fire Dragon, who came from a kid’s dream straight into Dragon City!

items.name: Hypno Dragon
items.description: A real trickster! The Hypno Dragon can make you believe you're a chicken or a frog! Spinning his spiral eyes he hypnotizes everyone who tries to resist his will. You'd better be his friend but wait... He has no friends! You'd better run!

items.name: Stressed Dragon
items.description: You may wonder if his crazy hairstyle is natural – and the answer is yes! Do you like it? Well, just don't ask him how he does it, because you need to be really stressed out to have such crazy hair!

items.name: Troglodyte Dragon
items.description: This dragon is also known as a “cave dweller.” He likes to live in caves or beneath overhanging rocks of cliffs. If you give him tinder and flint, he will make a perfect cozy fire in a few minutes!

items.name: Mold Dragon
items.description: Poor Mould Dragon… He doesn’t have many friends because other dragons find him disgusting and when he is sleeping, they confuse him for rotten garbage and try to throw him away. Truth is he’s a really nice buddy!

items.name: Rockfeller Dragon
items.description: This 90's tycoon knows how to make a fortune. He'll produce gold for you to collect if you get him. You won't regret this investment!

items.name: King Solomon Dragon
items.description: Solomon is the most powerful of the king dragons. He's also known for his sense of justice: what's mine is mine and what's yours is yours. It's best to keep this in mind if you think about sharing something with him!

items.name: Scrooge Dragon
items.description: The Scrooge Dragon might seem a bit cold-hearted at first, and indeed he is, but he is also a financial genius! If he includes you in his will, you'll never want for gold, gems or tomatoes again.

items.name: Robin Hood Dragon
items.description: Villains and bad guys, stop here! He will have your gold, if you please! You might remember this dragon from folk tales, but now you can have him on your side. Provided you're also generous about sending gold as gifts to your friends.

items.name: Wrestler Dragon
items.description: Are you ready to get this dragon into the battle arena? His thousands of fans will be watching him and expecting him to win, because he is the star!

items.name: Clover Dragon
items.description: One, two, three, four…five-leaf clover! Assured and confident, this dragon never fails. You could say that he was born under a lucky star. Other dragons feel luckier when they’re close to the Clover Dragon. Will you be luckier when you get him?

items.name: Poker Dragon
items.description: He holds all the cards. Or is he bluffing? Sometimes in life you have to take risks, but it's best not to when you're playing with the Poker Dragon. In Las Vegas, he's the boss.

items.name: Juggler Dragon
items.description: This Dragon is an amazing performer. His tricks and talent are beyond anything you have seen so far. Be careful as well, as he is one cunning adversary.

items.name: Ace Dragon
items.description: The Ace Dragon is a master at playing poker and other card games. You’ll have to be sharp to beat him in a poker tournament!

items.name: Speed Dragon
items.description: The Speed Dragon is, as you may guess, the fastest dragon in Dragon City! He's never late when meeting friends and likes to run wherever he goes. You can always find him training at the track! Beep beep!

items.name: Strong Dragon
items.description: The Strong Dragon was born in a gym... So it's not difficult to understand his passion for exercise. You don't want to make him angry, for he can tear you to pieces with his claws!

items.name: Master Dragon
items.description: This dragon is truly a master when it comes to controlling the elements. Its masterful nature makes its attacks a mystical masterclass. Be careful when training it as it's already a master in disguise.

items.name: Big Claws Dragon
items.description: Want to hear an annoying sound? Then come close to the Big Claws Dragon’s habitat when he is filing his claws. He can’t be told not to do it though. It’s the way he trains for battle.

items.name: Chimera Dragon
items.description: A dragon wrought of the immortal flame! The head of a lion with the body of a snake, he has goat horns and he breathes a terrible flame of bright fire. Watch your enemies tremble at the sight of the Chimera Dragon.

items.name: Eclipse Dragon
items.description: The sun hides when the Eclipse Dragon rises. Old civilizations knew about this mythic dragon and could predict his appearances. When he was coming, they would prepare themselves with UV400 sunglasses to enjoy the show!

items.name: Specter Dragon
items.description: Some dragons enjoy living in shadows and darkness. This is the case of the Specter Dragon. When he gets bored he likes to scare other dragons, which makes him quite unpopular with his peers.

items.name: Cat Dragon
items.description: Cats are lovely. We all love to feed them, stroke them, play with them... and watch them on video! You'll enjoy seeing your cute Cat Dragon playing in his habitat. But don't forget to use him in battle too. He'll scratch your most fearsome opponents.

items.name: Crossfire Dragon
items.description: Of all his impressive features, the Crossfire Dragon is most proud of the magic tattoos on his body. Each tattoo grants the dragon a different power. The mix of all of them makes him a hard opponent to fight!

items.name: Greenfluid Dragon
items.description: The amazing Greenfluid Dragon was created from the magical goo of dragonstone. It has great powers and can change from fluid to solid in no time.

items.name: Frozen Wind Dragon
items.description: If you suddenly notice goosebumps on your arms and your nose goes cold, it could be that the Frozen Wind Dragon is near! Ignore this message if you notice these symptoms when opening your fridge.

items.name: Aztec Warrior Dragon
items.description: Hiding deep in the jungle, this amazing warrior can wait days and days, until his prey is defenseless. Then, when he strikes, one single blow is usually enough for him to defeat his enemy.

items.name: Aztec Priest Dragon
items.description: The stars hold no secrets for the Aztec Priest Dragon. His knowledge of the universe is as famous as his amazing cape, made from real dragon skin.

items.name: Aztec Emperor Dragon
items.description: He commands armies of thousands. His people love him. He has dominated and won dozens of wars. It's understandable that after all this stress, he has relaxed a little. And maybe gotten a little bit chubby.

items.name: Chobby Dragon
items.description: Don’t bother telling Chobby Dragon he’s cool. He knows he is! It’s like “The Emperor’s New Clothes” – if you can’t see his coolness, it’s because you’re dumb!

items.name: Jamaican Dragon
items.description: The most laid-back dragon around. He likes lying on the grass and playing his bongos. He also spends long hours braiding his dreadlocks. Don’t even try to stress him out because that won’t work on him.

items.name: Blind Dragon
items.description: Sometimes what looks like a weakness is actually a strength! The Blind Dragon has developed amazing hearing and smelling skills, making him perfect for espionage and mushroom finding!

items.name: Cookie Dragon
items.description: Crunchy and sweet, the Cookie Dragon breeds perfectly with the Milk Dragon. Wait! Does the Milk Dragon even exist? Who knows, but what we know for sure is that Santa brings bigger presents to Cookie Dragon Masters!

items.name: Elements Dragon
items.description: This dragon is perfection itself! Its elements are combined in such a way that no one element is more important than another, making it hard to find a balance between all of them.

items.name: Manglar Dragon
items.description: This dragon likes to live in the rainforest. He can camouflage himself to blend in with nature. The Manglar Dragon is peaceful and strong as an ox!

items.name: Giant Wings Dragon
items.description: Some dragons have tiny wings, others have big wings and a few have giant wings! That’s the case of the Giant Wings Dragon, which can fly higher than any other dragon!

items.name: Amethyst Dragon
items.description: One of the most beautiful dragons in the world, Amethyst Dragon is the sister of the Quartz Dragon! As you can imagine, her skin is pretty tough as it is made of mineral – not like her heart which is lovely and soft.

items.name: Peace Dragon
items.description: The Peace Dragon spreads love and peace all over Dragon City. Be careful though, if you are not peaceful enough you will suffer the consequences!

items.name: Desert Dragon
items.description: The Desert Dragon comes from the most arid place in the world and is used to high temperatures. He is so big because he stores lots of water under his rocky skin! This allows him to survive many weeks without drinking!

items.name: Heart Dragon
items.description: The Heart Dragon is pure tenderness, soft and sweet. He will give you back all the love you give him and then some more. If you hug him, you won't be able to let him go.

items.name: Twister Dragon
items.description: Six wings for a sea dragon may seem too many, but watch what happens when he surfaces! Just by twisting his body this awesome dragon can create the most destructive whirlwinds and tornadoes.

items.name: Sylvan Dragon
items.description: Sylvan Dragons are the guardians that keep the dark shadows away from the elven woods. They are born and raised in the deepest parts of the forest, where they are trained to be a light force of nature.

items.name: Cosmo Dragon
items.description: Raise your head and look at the sky on a clear night to see the incredible Cosmo Dragon fly. Created from star dust and earth sand, his skin reminds us of the night and his wings of the universe's greatness.

items.name: Columbus Dragon
items.description: Dragopher Columbus is well known for discovering the flying islands in 1492. All the dragons you own live on the islands he discovered!

items.name: Bavarian Dragon
items.description: Lift up your stein and give us a loud "Prost!" for the Bavarian Dragon. He and all the other dragons are enjoying some pretzels and later they're going to dance on the tables.

items.name: Big Rockstar Dragon
items.description: A bad boy. A true rockstar. A master of rule breaking. He can play 5-hour long riffs on his guitar and he only stops for little whiles to enjoy a good steak.

items.name: Frankie Dragon
items.description: Did Doctor Frank really put together different dragon parts to create a new dragon? It does look quite scary! When it's dark, the Frankie Dragon sneaks around and scares other dragons.

items.name: Halloween Dragon
items.description: The Halloween Dragon is the master of pranks. Whenever he throws his head in the air, you'll hear people scream in shock. This is how he gets his kicks!

items.name: Animation Dragon
items.description: It's been a while since dragons evolved from frozen frames and began to walk, fly and fight! And it's all thanks to the animation wizards and magi! The Animation Dragon was the first of his kind, which is why he's so special and loved by all.

items.name: Joseon Dragon
items.description: Rising up from Korea, the Joseon Dragon comes back to fight. Blast your enemies with the power of water and fire! Stand strong against attacks with the element of metal. The Joseon Dragon has been revealed to the world!

items.name: Sensei Dragon
items.description: The Sensei Dragon is surrounded by a mystical aura and you can feel his magical presence whenever you are near him. He is so powerful that he was born in his adult stage (lvl 10)!

items.name: Oni Dragon
items.description: This Oni Dragon may have been a fearsome demon long ago but he discovered the power of QI and, in his attempt to become the strongest demon, he became peaceful and wise. He might not look like an ogre, but watch out, he can eat you in one bite!

items.name: Hearts Queen Dragon
items.description: It is far better to be feared than loved. That's what the Hearts Queen Dragon says. She may not be the best for breeding, but you should try her in battle! Sentence first, verdict later! Off with their heads!

items.name: Big Hat Dragon
items.description: It's tea time! Let's switch places! This energetic dragon can seem a bit crazy at first, and he may well be, given that he's known as the Mad Hatter. Get him and your tea parties will rock!

items.name: Quartz Dragon
items.description: Quartz is the element that the ancient druids used in their armors and rituals. It was the Quartz Dragon who taught the celtic civilization the special characteristics of this rock.

items.name: Dark Elf Dragon
items.description: The Dark Elf Dragon slips from the shadows of night to slay his enemies. He is as silent as an elephant and as persistent as a snake... or was it the other way around?

items.name: Sunset Dragon
items.description: The best time to see this dragon is at sunset. Some people confuse him for a giant bat or a vampire dragon because of the way he looks. It is said that he can block the sun with his giant wings and his impressive stature.

items.name: Snowman Dragon
items.description: Snowmen are one of the loveliest things you'll see at Christmas. But a Snow Man Dragon is simply irresistible! Be careful not to hug him too tight or he could melt!

items.name: Xmas Elf Dragon
items.description: Santa's best employee, this dragon is the manager of all the elves. Known for handing out candy to children, the Xmas Elf Dragon is the most wanted this season. You will find him by the sound of the bell that hangs from his tail.

items.name: Necromancer Dragon
items.description: The Necromancer Dragon likes to communicate with the deceased, summoning their spirits or raising their bodies from the dead. He uses the deceased as a source for hidden knowledge or as weapons. Rumor has it that he uses black magic to fuel his powerful spells.

items.name: Yoyo Dragon
items.description: Small-sized but big-hearted, this little dragon carries the fate of us all. All that is gold does not glitter, so don't judge by appearances because even the smallest dragon can change the future.

items.name: Shogun Dragon
items.description: This Japanese commander has the power of 100 dragons, but his main virtue is his calm mind on the battlefield. Victory is the only result he knows, and to keep his honor he will perform harakiri with no hesitation!

items.name: Martial Arts Dragon
items.description: A master in Ansatsuken, he's always improving, no matter the difficulty, no matter the cost. He can't avoid fighting for the innocent when he sees injustice. He's the only one who has mastered the Hadoken technique.

items.name: Hawaiian Dragon
items.description: This dragon has great rhythm, stunning moves and always feels the groove. These are perfect qualities for this fun and festive dragon. He's the first to arrive at any Hawaiian party!

items.name: Surf Dragon
items.description: If you don't see this dragon at first, you probably need to get atop some tall waves. Keep your eyes peeled. When he rides a surfboard, it's art in motion!

items.name: Ukulele Dragon
items.description: This dragon has got the rhythm! Once he starts playing his ukulele, the groove spreads to all the other dragons, and they start dancing with him. His good vibes are contagious!

items.name: Steam Dragon
items.description: This unique dragon is pure boiler pressure! With his rare combination of elements, he developed his own element – Steam! This inexhaustible energy source will meet all your needs.

items.name: Howl Dragon
items.description: After being bitten by a werewolf, this creature became a hybrid of beast and dragon. While the Howl Dragon's element is Dark, he is also connected to Nature and Energy Elements.

items.name: Magnet Dragon
items.description: Nowadays, the power of magnetism is no secret for us and we know it is the most powerful force on earth. Breeding this dragon will be as difficult as getting two positive poles together!

items.name: Quake Dragon
items.description: Some earthquakes are caused by tectonic plates – others occur when a Quake Dragon lands. This sudden release of seismic power can destroy towns and cities; thank God you are on a flying island!

items.name: Apocalypse Dragon
items.description: The most powerful of the four-elements-dragons, he spells the end of an era! With his combination of four opposite elements, the Apocalypse Dragon is pure destruction – albeit unintentionally. He is so difficult to breed that you may never see one.

items.name: Millennium Dragon
items.description: The most ancient of all four-element-dragons can finally be yours! Within the Millennium Dragon lurks the infinite power of time. The rare combination of its elements makes it unique and matchless.

items.name: Forge Dragon
items.description: The most incandescent of all four-element-dragons is the one that inhabits the center of the earth. Flying between lava flows, the Forge Dragon is in charge of keeping the planet's core molten.

items.name: Promethium Dragon
items.description: The most unpredictable of all four-element-dragons. He is the lord of quantum mechanics; his body is pure energy, so he can control all matter surrounding him. Don't get too close, he's radioactive!

items.name: Abyss Dragon
items.description: The most unknown of all four-element-dragons. He combines the most antagonistic pairs of elements. Coming from the deep unknown, he is the master of light and darkness, fire and ice. Expect the unexpected!

items.name: Mirage Dragon
items.description: The most elusive of all four-element-dragons. For years, the Mirage Dragon was considered a myth - a fabrication of a few crazed Dragon Masters. Today we know he is real, but that doesn't mean he's easy to breed!

items.name: Supersonic Dragon
items.description: The fastest of all four-element-dragons. The Supersonic Dragon is difficult to attain He flies ten times the speed of sound and strikes before anybody can hear him coming. You'd better build a pretty nice habitat or he will leave before you even see him.

items.name: Core Dragon
items.description: The Core Dragon is one of the space dragons. He is in charge of creating new planets. As a Dragon Master, you'd be pleased to have him in your city.

items.name: Basilisk Dragon
items.description: This dragon is a descendant of the great Basilisk from an age long forgotten. He has all the traits and wit of his ancestors, but has developed some new abilities too.

items.name: Dolphin Dragon
items.description: From the SocialPoint Fan Art contest comes the Dolphin Dragon! It's said that these animals are social, but this particular one prefers a "like" to a sardine!

items.name: Easter Dragon
items.description: This funny tiny dragon is here to bring colored eggs and candy to all the good little dragons. It is so cute and sweet... But don't lick him! This one is not made of chocolate!

items.name: Bookday Dragon
items.description: This dragon is literature's greatest defender. Thanks to him, good stories survive for centuries and are passed down from generation to generation.

items.name: Lightbeam Dragon
items.description: Such a beautiful thing! This mystic and noble dragon is one of the rarest of its kind. The Lightbeam Dragon is one of the space dragons. He will fill your breeding cave with pure essence.

items.name: Double Terra Dragon
items.description: Don't be alarmed, it's not an earthquake but a dignified Double Terra Dragon! These guys aren't known for their beauty, but for their love of dirt and their extremely humble and honest nature.

items.name: Earth Day Dragon
items.description: This dragon only appears once a year during Earth Day! What an amazing sight for sore eyes. Be sure to catch him on this special day.

items.name: Double Nature Dragon
items.description: The Double Nature Dragon loves humans, animals and all living things, some of them for gastronomic purposes. Even though never known to eat whole human being, a finger or two have been lost...

items.name: Double Flame Dragon
items.description: If you can't take the heat, stay away from the Double Flame Dragon! This temperamental creature is easily set off, but calms down equally fast and always feels deep remorse for the things it burned.

items.name: Double Electric Dragon
items.description: The tale tells us this dragon was born in a great storm that took place in the dark ages when an ordinary dragon got hit by a lightning. Since that day, you can see them on the skies, looking for a shock.

items.name: Double Ice Dragon
items.description: With the recent climate changes, the super cool Double Ice Dragons have migrated to the North Pole. If you see one in a warm place, please direct them to the nearest ice rink and you'll have a friend forever.

items.name: Double Metal Dragon
items.description: A robust dragon, drawn towards all things of metal. The word on the island is that what the Double Metal Dragon lacks in intellect, it more than makes up in determination.

items.name: Double Sea Dragon
items.description: If you're into water sports, then the Double Sea Dragon will be your new best friend. They are often mistaken for seals or dolphins!

items.name: Mother's Day Dragon
items.description: This dragon has an unconditional love for her babies. She is loving and warm so her grateful babies return the affection on this special day. Happy mother's day!

items.name: Felidae Dragon
items.description: This creature likes living in the wild, but he's had a very hard life, always running away from hunters who want his skin as a trophy. Put him on your island and he'll be your proud partner, grateful for having been saved.

items.name: Space Dragon
items.description: Time is relative, especially for this dragon. He was born during the big bang in the oldest part of the universe. Since then he has been traveling between galaxies creating new planets.

items.name: Kaiju Dragon
items.description: This horrifying Kaiju Dragon was first seen in 1954. It is said that he was born from atomic explosions, but he loves tomatoes, too. Some people know him as the King of the Monsters!

items.name: Acoustic Dragon
items.description: This unusually shaped dragon has the special ability to redirect soundwaves at will! While this may not seem super useful, it allows him to know all the secrets and gossip from Dragon City.

items.name: Unity Dragon
items.description: This elegant space dragon is the guardian of balance. He leads his fellow dragons, but he's not a leader. As an integral part the cosmos, he ensures that all universal forces flow in a common direction.

items.name: Anniversary Dragon
items.description: We have been together for two years... It's time to celebrate! But what a surprise! Inside the cake we baked together with Cookie Dragon, a new dragon has been found! The Anniversary Dragon has arrived.

items.name: Cheshire Cat Dragon
items.description: The Cheshire Cat Dragon loves to appear and disappear at will! Sometimes it raises philosophical points to annoy or baffle other inhabitants of Dragon City.

items.name: Pterodactyl Dragon
items.description: The scariest dragon of the Jurassic period has come to join his fellows. You may be afraid of his teeth and spikes, but beware his claws that can split you in two.

items.name: Zodiac Taurus Dragon
items.description: Taurus is one of the Zodiac Dragons who give their names to our constellations. This dragon is known as The Heavenly Bull. He is full of positive energy and is always happy to assist those close to him.

items.name: Zodiac Gemini Dragon
items.description: Gemini is one of the Zodiac Dragons who give their names to our constellations. This dragon is associated with the twins Castor and Pollux of the Greek mythology. It is said that the Gemini Dragon is the protector of sailors.

items.name: Zodiac Cancer Dragon
items.description: Cancer is one of the Zodiac Dragons who give their names to our constellations. This dragon is associated with the crab Karkynos in Greek mythology. It is said that Cancer is very respected and feared, as he fought Hercules in ancient times.

items.name: Zodiac Leo Dragon
items.description: Leo is one of the Zodiac Dragons who give their names to our constellations. This dragon is a descendant of the Nemean Lion, who liked to take hostages to its lair in a cave. You'd better watch out!

items.name: Zodiac Virgo Dragon
items.description: Virgo is one of the Zodiac Dragons who give their names to our constellations. This dragon is associated with agriculture and he holds the scales of justice in his hands. Wherever he is, food and happiness abound.

items.name: Zodiac Libra Dragon
items.description: Libra is one of the Zodiac Dragons who give their names to our constellations. This dragon stands for truth and justice and is respected by all dragons in Dragon City.

items.name: Zodiac Scorpio Dragon
items.description: Scorpio is one of the Zodiac Dragons who give their names to our constellations. The rest of the dragons fear his strong, poisonous stinger. You'd better not make him angry!

items.name: Zodiac Sagittarius Dragon
items.description: Sagittarius is one of the Zodiac Dragons who give their names to our constellations. It is known as one of the wisest dragons in Dragon City. Everyone listens to his advice.

items.name: Zodiac Capricorn Dragon
items.description: Capricorn is one of the Zodiac Dragons who give their names to our constellations. Dating back to ancient times, the origin of this hybrid dragon is unknown. According to the legend, his parents were a goat and a fish dragon.

items.name: Zodiac Aquarius Dragon
items.description: Aquarius is one of the Zodiac Dragons who give their names to our constellations. This dragon is identified as Gu La, the "Great One," and he loves to spend time playing and diving in the water!

items.name: Zodiac Pisces Dragon
items.description: Pisces is one of the Zodiac Dragons who give their names to our constellations. According to legend, this dragon liked to dive in the water all the time, and finally became more fish than dragon!

items.name: Crowned Dragon
items.description: This dragon as known as "O Rei", as you can see from his crown. Wherever he plays soccer, he is praised and respected by other dragons.

items.name: Cheerful Dragon
items.description: This dragon is considered the heir of the O Rei Dragon. Don't be fooled by his young appearance, his electrifying movements are difficult to see, and he can beat his opponents in the blink of an eye!

items.name: Adored Dragon
items.description: Pelusa is frequently mistaken for his brother, Deus, because of his godly qualities. He is adored and revered by the other dragons for his mastery of the soccer ball.

items.name: Speedy Dragon
items.description: The Pulga Dragon is considered the heir to Pelusa Dragon. It is said that his mastery of the soccer ball is even greater, and this generates lots of debate in the dragon society. It is said that he is somehow linked to Deus...

items.name: Fastshoot Dragon
items.description: The Orange Dragon is known for his technical ability, speed, acceleration and dribbling, but his greatest quality is vision. He is able to detect and predict the movements of his opponents, which makes him a fearsome adversary!

items.name: Sportive Dragon
items.description: Known by everyone as one of the calmest and most elegant dragons. A hero and example to many, he is respected and admired wherever he goes. Don't irritate him, as he can defeat you before you have time to react!

items.name: Brawny Dragon
items.description: The Ranoldo Dragon is as fast as lightning, with the power and strength of ten thousand bulls. Don't mess around with him unless you want to make him angry - if you do, it will be the end of you!

items.name: Slam Dragon
items.description: Despite his physical appearance, the Zizou Dragon is one of the most elegant and intelligent dragons in Dragon City. He is very diplomatic with everyone, but he won't hesitate to use force if necessary.

items.name: Father's Day Dragon
items.description: This dragon loves his children unconditionally and protects them. He is loving and warm, so his grateful children return the affection on this special day. Happy Father's Day!

items.name: Princess Dragon
items.description: The Princess Dragon is one of the most beautiful creatures in Dragon City. Her long blond hair dazzles everyone who looks at her. You'll fall in love with her!

items.name: Little Red Riding Hood Dragon
items.description: This dragon loves to go for long walks in the forest to bring food to her sick grandmother. If one day you happen to find her in the countryside walking around, you can ask her for a piece of the delicious cake she carries in her basket!

items.name: Adventure Dragon
items.description: This is probably one of the most adventurous dragons on the flying islands! It is always hunting for ancient treasures, solving mysteries and breaking curses. You’ll never be bored!

items.name: Cyborg Dragon
items.description: Sent from the future, this cyborg has come to Dragon City to serve and protect it from villains. Half dragon, half machine, he has mighty strength.

items.name: Da Vinci Dragon
items.description: One of the most talented creatures in Dragon City, the Da Vinci Dragon is an architect, sculptor, engineer, inventor and painter who delights the inhabitants with his works of art.

items.name: Korean Soccer Dragon
items.description: The ancestors of this dragon happened to make a home at a soccer stadium and that's how it all started. The dragons began watching games and finally learned how to play themselves.

items.name: Independence Day Dragon
items.description: Happy Independence Day! This dragon was born on the 4th of July, 1776, and helped the Americans in their fight for independence with his courage and determination. He is the most patriotic dragon in Dragon City.

items.name: Genie Dragon
items.description: From the 2nd Social Point Fan Art contest comes the Genie Dragon! It is said that these creatures can grant three wishes! Choose wisely and make your dreams come true!

items.name: Shaolin Dragon
items.description: Shaolin kung fu is one of the oldest and most famous martial arts.This dragon is a Shaolin warrior from the Buddhist Temple on the Songshan Mountain and has exceptional martial art skills.

items.name: Sorcerer Dragon
items.description: This dragon is one of a few remaining sorcerers, hunters for hire gifted with supernatural powers. Despite its appearance, it always protects and defends the helpless… even if its methods are sometimes considered politically incorrect.

items.name: Hellgate Dragon
items.description: Hellgate is a tricky one. He makes dragons who go to hell believe that if they bribe him they will be able to avoid the fires but, after accepting the gifts, he throws them in with no mercy!

items.name: Albino Dragon
items.description: The Albino Dragon is a rare creature in Dragon City. He's the only dragon with no skin color, and when he's angry he shines so bright he can blind his enemies. When this happens, he doesn't waste the chance to give them what they deserve.

items.name: Gold Rush Dragon
items.description: This dragon is a tireless seeker, a hard worker who won't stop until he finds what is most precious to him. The gold fever is running through his veins!

items.name: Apache Dragon
items.description: A friend of peace. Fearless and honorable. The Apache dragon might seem like an unfriendly warrior at first, but he follows a code of honor, which makes him memorable and a valuable ally.

items.name: Sheriff Dragon
items.description: This dragon is always looking out for the welfare of others. Defender of the helpless, this tireless avenger always has troublemakers in its sights.

items.name: Mozart Dragon
items.description: His musical notes sweeten the ear of everyone in Dragon City. A master like no other with a gift that makes him unique in its kind.

items.name: Hansel & Gretel Dragon
items.description: This playful two-headed dragon was on the verge of being devoured by the wicked witch of the dragons but was saved by the combined cunning of his two heads. Two are better than one!

items.name: Detective Dragon
items.description: When night falls and darkness descends upon the weak, the Detective Dragon will get to the bottom of things. This creature is the best at solving mysteries.

items.name: Astronaut Dragon
items.description: The first dragon on the moon. He is a living Dragon City legend. It takes supernatural efforts to go as far as he went. Not any dragon can do it..

items.name: Brave Sword Dragon
items.description: This dragon is a born leader, a fighter who will not rest until it frees the whole dragon nation from any oppressors or tyrants who try to subdue it. A true example of honor and loyalty.

items.name: Scientific Dragon
items.description: With a super high IQ, Scientific Dragon dedicates his life to researching and solving the everydayproblems of all dragons. It's a lot tougher than it looks!

items.name: Red Egg Dragon
items.description: This awesome dragon doesn't care about what came first, the dragon or the egg. It really doesn't matter to him because it took both for him to be born!

items.name: Mystic Tribe Dragon
items.description: This mystical creature comes from a peculiar culture with very strange customs: he eats once a day, but only if it's sunny, and when he sleeps, it is always while resting on his left wing. The Mystic Tribe Dragon is a very odd dragon, indeed!

items.name: Nocturnal Dragon
items.description: The Nocturnal Dragon does not care for praise or worship. Nor does he seek them. He simply enjoys watching from the night sky, where he is protected by the shadows.

items.name: Longhorn Dragon
items.description: The Longhorn Dragon is a machine capable of crushing everything in its path. It uses its great horn and its size to defend itself from the attacks of other dragons.

items.name: Sleeping Beauty Dragon
items.description: Sleeping Beauty Dragon is one of the most beautiful dragons in the kingdom. Many fight to win her heart, but she remains pure in the hope of finding the dragon that awakened her from her sleep.

items.name: Mystic Plant Dragon
items.description: This dragon was born into a cult of Nature Dragon lovers. Nature Dragons have mystical powers, and their solemn, dignified look make them highly respected by their peers.

items.name: Explosive Dragon
items.description: The Explosive Dragon has a burning fire inside that is always on the verge of exploding. It is a bold, fierce and unpredictable dragon capable of wreaking havoc.

items.name: Necro Dragon
items.description: Because of his appearance, the Necro Dragon doesn't have much success breeding in Dragon City. Once a handsome dragon, the use of black magic twisted his appearance to resemble an undead dragon.

items.name: Allure Dragon
items.description: The Allure Dragon evokes all kinds of feelings in his wake. The female dragons go crazy for him, and he makes other dragons envious because of his attractive physical appearance.

items.name: Sad Dragon
items.description: Sad Dragon is always sad! Surprise Party? Sad. New Island? Sad. Tomato Menu? Sad. We don't know what makes him happy!

items.name: Spiky Dragon
