items.description: He was born in a hostile territory, the Dragon City mountains, and it is not easy to survive up there, but for the Spiky Dragon it is a piece of cake. With that massive spine armor and those jaws, who would dare to mess with him?

items.name: Amber Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! This peaceful, honey-colored dragon is one of the most respected members in the community. Other dragons come to him for advice because he is unbelievably wise.

items.name: Krait Dragon
items.description: Krait Dragon was cast out of Krait society because he felt differently about the Krait way of life compared to the other dragons.

items.name: Golem Dragon
items.description: Golem arrives in Dragon City alone, disoriented, and overwhelmed. Sensing the fears and desires of those around him, he must keep himself from being drawn in, or he risks revealing his nature.

items.name: Ragnor Dragon
items.description: The Ragnor Dragon is a snake that can move quickly in the mountain terrain where he lives. He can inflict real pain with his tail of fire.

items.name: Dark Angel Dragon
items.description: The Dark Angel Dragon was cast away to the realm of mortal dragons because of his disobedience and rebellion. He possesses Light elements by nature and has acquired Dark elements from his betrayals.

items.name: Copy
items.description: If you can't take the heat, stay away from the Flame Dragon! This temperamental creature is easily set off, but calms down equally fast and always feels deep remorse for the things it burned.

items.name: Mystic Blizzard Dragon
items.description: He spends long hours grooming his majestic white fur. After all, without it, he wouldn’t survive his own ice storms, which are lethal for the rest of the dragons. He breathes - you turn into an ice cube.

items.name: Adamantium Dragon
items.description: The metal alloy he’s made of is indestructible. His long, flexible body allows him to trap all his rivals at once and everyone knows there’s no way out of an adamantium knot!

items.name: Citadel Dragon
items.description: Deus has entrusted the city's security to him, and it’s a task he is completely devoted to. He will proudly become the royal guard of your island. Strangers shall not pass while Citadel Dragon is in charge.

items.name: Mystic War Dragon
items.description: The Mystic War Dragon is a camouflage expert. He’s so good at hiding that you often won’t see him at all, but he’s definitely watching you, and with his sharp claws at the ready! This is your chance to put him on your island!

items.name: Dark Jaws Dragon
items.description: This huge beast has the strongest jaws around. He can rip apart anything in his way in seconds. That, added to a short temper, makes for a dangerous combination.

items.name: Secret Fire Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! When the gem on his chest came into contact with igneous rocks, the Secret Fire Dragon was born. How the gem remained undestroyed after drowning in magma…, that is a mystery that no one has been able to explain yet. What we do know is that the fire in his eyes never goes out, which is also mysterious… and fearsome.

items.name: Boss Dragon
items.description: He’s the patriarch of a dynasty of dragons who controls the black market for food and gold. The authorities of Dragon City tried to catch him for years but they all died in suspicious circumstances so, to be safe, stay out of his way! Capisci?

items.name: Rem Dragon
items.description: The Rem Dragon has a special power: he can see into the thoughts of others when they sleep. At night he's wide awake, studying them and planning the best way to use their fears against them in battle.

items.name: Frost Dragon
items.description: This majestic creature was born and raised high up in the mountains. His combination of thick fur and feathers has allowed him to survive the cold. He’s also an astute warrior - great to have by your side in battle!

items.name: Christreen Dragon
items.description: Because the Christreen Dragon looks so much like a Fir tree it makes him want to bring the same joy that these trees do at Christmas time. When the holidays arrive, he puts on shiny decorations and sails the skies. People make wishes when they see him!

items.name: Mistletoe Dragon
items.description: The Mistletoe Dragon went to the city only once. The fact that all the lovers kissed as he walked past them made him pretty sad! He went back to the woods, feeling lonely, and now he only comes out for battle.

items.name: Motherly Dragon
items.description: A mother will always be there for her babies. She can forgive them for spitting fire at each other and stealing food from the farms. Having them back home safe and sound is all that matters at the end of the day.

items.name: The Amazing Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! He is the one, the only, the invincible, the unique… The Amaaaazing Dragon! Watch him defy gravity tonight, at the Dragon City Circus!

items.name: Prophet Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! The Prophet Dragon is contacted by supernatural powers and he speaks for them. In Dragon City, he’s like an intermediary between Deus and the earthly dragons.

items.name: Flawless Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! She wakes up, flawless. Posts up, flawless. Flying around the place, flawless. Shining around the town, flawless. This dragon, flawless. My dragon, flawless.

items.name: Rudolph Dragon
items.description: The Rudolph Dragon is in charge of protection Santa Claus Village. His job is a very important one, because if he fails, kids won’t get their Christmas presents! The good news is, he’s never failed: winter storms won’t stop him!

items.name: Balloon Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! This dragon swallowed a large amount of helium when he was little, which gave him a really squeaky roar and made him float around his habitat. Now he can’t come down!

items.name: Dreamcatcher Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! Dreamcatchers filter out all bad dreams and only allow good thoughts into our mind. That’s why the dragons that live close to the Dreamcatcher Dragon are immensely positive.

items.name: Bride Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! She hasn’t found the dragon of her dreams yet, but when she does, she will be by his side for better, for worse, for richer, for poorer, in sickness and in health, until death do them part.

items.name: Gurgle Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! This affable creature enjoys being around children. They love to pop him and see how he puts himself together again. He also smells really good.

items.name: Naughty Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! The Naughty Dragon is two-faced. He tells some friends lies about other friends to turn them against each other, so don’t ever believe anything that comes from him!

items.name: Underworld Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! Underneath the streets there’s a whole world. The Underworld Dragon is the king there. He knows the sewage system by heart and uses it to go out and capture followers for his kingdom.

items.name: Red Rose Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! Every rose has its thorns, and the Red Rose Dragon has a particularly dangerous bunch of them. Its wings are beautiful to see, just don’t get too close.

items.name: Mermaid Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! She grew up under the protection of Poseadus, Baron of the Mermaids, but now she is strong and ready to fly by her own wings, or, in this case, swim by her own tail.

items.name: Illusion Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! It's hard to distinguish between real life and illusion when this dragon is around. As a good-natured experiment he likes to create visions inside others' minds.

items.name: Chakra Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World! Chakras are the energy centers in our body in which energy flows through. The Chakra Dragon is an expert in finding these centers and making all the positive energy flow.

items.name: Touchdown Dragon
items.description: The Touchdown Dragon used to be picked on by everyone in high school, but one day he joined the football team and, as he was really good at it, he became the quarterback. Now he’s really popular.

items.name: Clay Dragon
items.description: Remember when you mixed clay of different colors and the result was always a brownish-bluish-purplish mess? The Clay Dragon doesn’t have this problem. It makes colors come together in a beautiful way.

items.name: Spring Dragon
items.description: When nature shows its brightest colors, this dragon comes out to play. It loves fresh grass - not only looking at it, but eating it too.

items.name: Twin Dragon
items.description: Oh, brothers. They fight each other all the time but when one has a problem, the other does his utmost to help his twin.

items.name: Celtic Dragon
items.description: The Celtic tribal society disappeared centuries ago, but this dragon remains as a vestige of it. Now it has come to Dragon City to represent the Celtic culture.

items.name: Aqualung Dragon
items.description: Aqualung was born a Terra Dragon, so he wasn’t naturally prepared to live in the sea, but he wanted so badly to be a Sea Dragon that he bought a diving dress to be able to live as one.

items.name: Seafloor Dragon
items.description: Part dragon, part coral reef. This creature is home to all sorts of limpets so, if you fight against it in battle, you’ll have to face its marine organisms too… and they’re not willing to lose their home!

items.name: Depth Dragon
items.description: When this dragon is little, it is hard to distinguish him from a crab, but when he grows up, he becomes quite impressive! Look out for the pincers on his wings.

items.name: Atlantean Dragon
items.description: The Atlantean Dragon is the proud guard of the Heart of Atlantis, a stone that contains all the secrets of the Atlantis Island. While he's on duty, no one shall take the stone.

items.name: Venetian Dragon
items.description: The Venetian Dragon’s logic tells him that his beautiful porcelain mask is anonymity and anonymity is freedom to do whatever he wants, without consequences! He never takes his mask off!

items.name: Mardi Gras Dragon
items.description: This dragon has come all the way from New Orleans to Dragon City to bring you jazz, fun and colors. He also cooks the best gumbo so you’re in for a treat!

items.name: Samba Dragon
items.description: You won’t find another dragon that can shake it like this! She can carry out lots of attacks but the really lethal thing about her is her samba dancing.

items.name: Eggster Dragon
items.description: The Eggster Dragon doesn’t want to grow up, he’s even refusing to leave the egg he was born from. He just wants to eat chocolate and play with the Bunny Dragon for the rest of his life.

items.name: Gingerbread Dragon
items.description: Deus baked the Gingerbread Dragon himself, and the result is delicious! He only has one flaw: He is terrified of milk!

items.name: Bunny Dragon
items.description: Easter is the Bunny Dragon’s favorite holiday. Every year he wears his bunny costume and plays hide and seek with the Eggster Dragon. The problem is that when these two come together, they can be quite mischievous…

items.name: Chocolate Dragon
items.description: When did chocolate become evil?! This dragon uses its deliciousness to attract its enemies and then blast them with chocolate bullets.

items.name: Box Dragon
items.description: He was born inside a box, and it was so comfy, safe and dark that he never felt like coming out. He hates when people open his side flaps to look inside. He has a bit of a temper...

items.name: Equinox Dragon
items.description: The Equinox Dragon has a theory: Everyone has a dark side and a light side. The secret to happiness is balancing these two in the same way an equinox balances day and night perfectly.

items.name: Sakura Dragon
items.description: Cherry blossoms usually represent ephemeral beauty. The Sakura Dragon is indeed beautiful, but its beauty, far from being evanescent, remains eternal.

items.name: Hope Dragon
items.description: Hope is the dream of the soul awake. Hope is the last thing you lose. Bring hope into your life and the Hope Dragon into your island!

items.name: Shakespeare Dragon
items.description: “To breed or not to breed, that is the question.”

items.name: Recycling Dragon
items.description: See how clean your islands look? You can thank the Recycling Dragon for that. It is also thanks to him that all the food leftovers are reused as stuffing for beds!

items.name: Flesh Dragon
items.description: This incredibly strong dragon has governed the Titan Island since he overthrew his own father. His ambition exceeded all bounds and now he has no friends, only subjects.

items.name: Dainty Dragon
items.description: Her beauty reminds us of her distant relatives, the unicorns. This dragon also has a very special characteristic: when wind goes through her lacelike wings, it sounds like perfectly tuned music.

items.name: Void Dragon
items.description: Blocked ears? That's probably because this dragon has silently appeared from a black hole by your side. Look around slowly, try not to get him upset...and run!

items.name: Rorschach Dragon
items.description: The same way baby dragons look for animals in the clouds when they look at the sky, adults like to find shapes in the Rorschach Dragon. What each of them sees says a lot about their personality.

items.name: Beholder Dragon
items.description: The eyes that this dragon has all over his body are there to distract his enemies. His inner eye is enough to look into their deepest fears. When he does this, he usually sees himself.

items.name: Mana Dragon
items.description: There are many sources of power and one of them is this dragon. With his help you can be invincible, but if he sees you’re not using your powers for good, he will take it all away in seconds.

items.name: Soldier Dragon
items.description: A committed defender of Dragon City. You’ll find him on guard at the frontiers or escorting Deus at habitat inaugurations. He doesn’t know any magical dragon attacks but, hey, he has a rifle.

items.name: Firefighter Dragon
items.description: Every Master who owns a decent amount of dragons of the Flame element should always have a Firefighter Dragon around. He can put out any fire, magical or not, in seconds.

items.name: Rockfire Dragon
items.description: On a cold night, a bandit assaulted a smithy. He was looking for valuables to steal when a beast appeared from inside the forge and scared him away. From that day, the beast is known as the Rockfire Dragon.

items.name: Black Swan Dragon
items.description: Beautiful doesn't mean good. The Black Swan Dragon may be beautiful, but she is shady and she likes to trick dragons into seeing things that aren't real. Be careful with her magic powers.

items.name: Ocean Dragon
items.description: Despite being born and raised in the ocean, this dragon can’t actually swim, he just walks on the ocean floor. His fins are not big enough to lift up such a massive creature!

items.name: Patriot Dragon
items.description: Oh say! Can you see by the dawn’s early light how this dragon can fly like he’s sailing the skies?

items.name: Orc Dragon
items.description: Forged during a cruel war raging in far-off lands, the Orc Dragon will fight with ferocity until the end of time.

items.name: Summer Dragon
items.description: This dragon loves swimming in the sea more than anything in this world! He's mostly happy and peaceful, but if you tread on a little kid's sand castle, he will make you regret it.

items.name: Infamous Dragon
items.description: The Infamous Dragon is a beast as dark on the inside as you can see he is on the outside. His heart is so cold that it chills his entire body. The iciest dragon of the Titan family!

items.name: Cyclops Dragon
items.description: This creature is blood-related to the Infamous Dragon and the Titan Dragon. He’s an expert at forging and has provided lots of dragons with fine weapons. However, when it comes to his own battles, he prefers brute strength.

items.name: Car Dragon
items.description: This dragon is a deadly partner in battle: a pet and a flying car! He can both give you a ride into battle and defeat all your enemies there.

items.name: Motorbike Dragon
items.description: Get your dragon running, head out on the highway, looking for adventure and whatever comes your way!

items.name: Mace Dragon
items.description: While Thor has his hammer, you have this dragon, which is actually much better. Not only can he strike with his tail, he also has quite a bite!

items.name: Faust Dragon
items.description: Powerful and confident, some nickname her “The Femme Fatale of Dragon City” because she can use her shiny blue eyes to drive her opponents so mad they attack themselves.

items.name: Sentence Dragon
items.description: Citizens with clean criminal records don’t even know who this dragon is but those who have broken the law fear him and hide from him whenever they see him, for he’s the one to carry out all of Deus’ sentences.

items.name: BigFace Dragon
items.description: When he was abducted, he got stuck in the entrance of the UFO. The suction was so strong that he began to swell and, by the time he got in, his face was irreversibly swollen. Now he’s known for this characteristic.

items.name: Dragotron Dragon
items.description: The latest experiment of the aliens: A baby dragon turned into a space robot — a robot so powerful that, used for bad, could be destructive. Master him and use its power and technology for good!

items.name: Fur Dragon
items.description: Aliens experiment with the dragons they abduct. On this occasion, they were trying to genetically modify a ball of wool and turn it into a living space dragon. The result was… furry.

items.name: Molluck Dragon
items.description: The twisted mind of this experimental project. He thinks that the future of all dragons is to become aliens, so he wants to include them in his genetic experiments and turn them into space creatures at any cost.

items.name: Sword Wielder Dragon
items.description: This courageous dragon had a lonely childhood, which made him mature, solemn and somber, but also eager to prove himself as a warrior. You could take advantage of that, Dragon Master!

items.name: Brown Haired Dragon
items.description: A queen like no other: respected, feared and loved. She has created an army of her own descendants. Her conquests are mostly merciful, but she will take what is hers by fire if it’s necessary.

items.name: Golden Hand Dragon
items.description: His good looks and military expertise have made this dragon quite arrogant. An enemy cut off his hand and he had it replaced with a golden one that has become his most lethal weapon.

items.name: Cruel Dragon
items.description: In spite of being cowardly and tyrannical, this dragon still thinks he’s the greatest king the world has ever seen. He causes lots of problems and has an unstable personality. Will you be able to master him?

items.name: Graduation Dragon
items.description: It’s been four years of studying hard at the prestigious Dragon University but the day has finally arrived! He’s got a thousand memories, his graduation gown on… and a great summer ahead!

items.name: Cow Dragon
items.description: The farmers suspected that she wasn’t a real cow for years: Her milk was spicy and one fine day she grew wings! It was then that they decided to send her to Dragon City, where she would fit in better.

items.name: Pig Dragon
items.description: This pig is no Babe. It loves to torment the sheep and the other pigs. Even the farmer is afraid of it ever since he saw it flying by his window on a night of a full moon.

items.name: Sheep Dragon
items.description: Earthquakes happen when the Sheep Dragon bleats. Under all that lovely white wool there’s a cold black heart. This is a very dangerous creature.

items.name: Chicken Dragon
items.description: In the past, he used to stir up all the hens in his farmyard, so the farmer kicked him out. Now that he's in Dragon City, you’ll have to handle him carefully if you don’t want him to start a revolution.

items.name: White Alien Dragon
items.description: Blue Alien Dragon comes from a peculiar culture and has very strange customs: He eats but once a day and only if it's sunny. Not only that, when he sleeps, he always sleeps resting on his left wing. How odd this Blue Alien Dragon!

items.name: Impassible Dragon
items.description: This dragon is used to being the king wherever he goes. He doesn’t like anyone getting in his way or trying to outdo him. He will stop anyone catching up to him, by fair means or foul.

items.name: Spark Dragon
items.description: This dragon was born when an Electric Dragon and a Terra Dragon crashed into each other. They were really surprised when they saw they had produced an egg!

items.name: Chrome Dragon
items.description: His metal scales protect him from prying eyes. Other dragons can see their reflection on his scales. Some of them realized that they would rather not look into a mirror!

items.name: Iceberg Dragon
items.description: This dragon has a shell of ice that protects him from external threats and damage. He got his protective coating when a storm enveloped him with ice while he was sleeping.

items.name: Forestry Dragon
items.description: The master of all forests. They say that when he falls in love, trees blossom. On the other hand, if you see this dragon next to a withered tree, you should really stay away.

items.name: Fairy Dragon
items.description: A dragon and a fairy made a pact to protect each other's species. They asked Deus to create a sort of intermediary between the two species. That's how this dragon was born.

items.name: Wave Dragon
items.description: When the seas churn and the wind howls, this dragon is at his happiest. He loves to dive from high clifftops down into the depths of the ocean.

items.name: Anubis Dragon
items.description: He used to accompany the ancient Egyptians during their first days in the afterlife, just so they wouldn't be afraid. After 3000 years, he has decided to quit that job and devote his life to battle.

items.name: Voodoo Witcher Dragon
items.description: Try not to aggravate a Voodoo Witcher Dragon. All they need to ruin your life is a voodoo doll!

items.name: Supernova Dragon
items.description: There are entire galaxies mapped out on this dragon's skin. The positions of the little luminous dots move as the universe changes.

items.name: Fervor Dragon
items.description: He has the temperament of a demon and the greatness of a god. He's one of the leaders of the fire element.

items.name: Gravity Dragon
items.description: A prodigy of nature. He has a central magic that holds his body in balance. Gravity is his ally and, thanks to that, he’s never even lost a scale.

items.name: Petal Dragon
items.description: Counting the petals on its head won’t help you find out if the one you love loves you back, but this dragon's good for other things, like quests and breeding!

items.name: Amazone Dragon
items.description: Like all Amazons, she was trained in agriculture, hunting and the art of war; but it is her dragon nature that makes her the Amazon queen, the strongest warrior of them all.

items.name: Sap Dragon
items.description: This dragon is made entirely out of sap so it’s a very good friend of all the Nature Dragons. When they feel a bit dry they just rub themselves a bit against the Sap Dragon and they feel better.

items.name: Nisse Dragon
items.description: This forest dragon is known as “The Bad Lad” because of his mischievous attitude and his bad intentions. He loves guiding lost dragons to the dark part of the forest and abandoning them there.

items.name: Nazca Dragon
items.description: She has a sweet look but she takes advantage of all the travelers who dare to go through the forest. She doesn't let them continue with their journey unless they pay her.

items.name: Imp Dragon
items.description: This mischievous dragon is always seeking attention, but his pranks can be a bit upsetting sometimes. In the end, he's just a lonely little creature who gets too bored.

items.name: Handy Dragon
items.description: Broken statue? Handy Dragon’s there to fix it! Farm not working? Call the Handy Dragon! Leaky Sea Habitat? The Handy Dragon’s what you need!

items.name: Ifrit Dragon
items.description: This criminal has spent his whole life going in and out of prison. He started with common offenses, like stealing some tomatoes, but his latest felonies include setting fire to an entire city!

items.name: Soul Eater Dragon
items.description: Her name is so feared that most just call her “The Phantom Queen”. She absorbs her enemies’ souls and they’re left unable to feel anything, just wandering around empty-eyed.

items.name: Kooky Dragon
items.description: No one wants to be a subject in this scientist's experiments, so he tries his mad inventions on himself. Sometimes the results are great and sometimes… well, he ends up creating creepy hybrids.

items.name: Immortal Dragon
items.description: Rumor has it that when it was this dragon’s turn to die, he refused to cross The Styx; he stole Charon’s boat and used it to sail back to the world of the living.

items.name: Heat Dragon
items.description: When this dragon is angry and plotting his revenge, the heat goes up. Believe us, you do not want to feel the heat of his fury.

items.name: Valiant Dragon
items.description: This hero belongs to an old world, far away in both time and space, where only the strongest survived. Imagine how strong this dragon must be: He’s made it to our days and to our world!

items.name: Barley Dragon
items.description: Fresh and foamy and full to the brim with happiness, this mischievous creature loves parties and music festivals but also enjoys a quiet day out in the sun.

items.name: Homerun Dragon
items.description: He hits it high, he hits it deep and it goes straight past center field! The ball is out of here! It’s a home run, his seventh one this season! The Dragon City Champions tie the game.

items.name: Frostbite Dragon
items.description: It is hard to battle in winter. Fire Dragons have trouble lighting up their flames, Nature Dragons feel too sick to fight… Thankfully, this beast could even fight in the North Pole without shivering once.

items.name: Retired Dragon
items.description: Clear your mind must be if you are to master this dragon. Feed him well and train him you must. May the force be with you!

items.name: Cyber Dragon
items.description: He was born with a disease that made him weak, but his dream was to compete in the Dragon Leagues; so he built himself a suit of armor equipped with the best technology. Now he’s super strong!

items.name: Spartan Dragon
items.description: Dragons, prepare for glory. This tireless warrior has arrived to lead your troops to victory. Because this… is… Dragon City!

items.name: Evil Dragon
items.description: “The Abhorred” and “The Deceiver” are just two of the epithets used to name this feared dragon. He doesn’t need to see from behind his mask, for the eye on the top of his head can see everything.

items.name: Energy Dragon
items.description: This dragon concentrates so much energy that he’s like a walking big bang. He can create entire galaxies just by breathing. Impressive!

items.name: DéjàVu Dragon
items.description: Every time a new creature arrives to the island, the DéjàVu Dragon goes: “Heyyy, haven’t we met before?”. He can be a bit confusing.

items.name: Wonder Dragon
items.description: One of the most curious dragons. Wonder is a great observer of what surrounds him. He also has the most unexpected reactions to surprising events. It is quite enriching to be around him.

items.name: Asier Dragon
items.description: This dragon is a true fighter, a Dragon City hero. All the other dragons love him and know how great he is. Asier, you're our champion!

items.name: Amerindian Dragon
items.description: He is a great warrior but also a spiritual leader. He encourages all the other dragons to love and protect the land that Mother Nature has given them.

items.name: Sky Queen Dragon
items.description: She's not an actual queen, but she is so majestic when in flight that she looks like she could rule over all the dragons in the universe.

items.name: Boreal Dragon
items.description: This dragon can be found in Norway between the end of fall and the beginning of spring. He emerges to dance with the spirits whenever the northern lights are bright.

items.name: Obscure Dragon
items.description: Here's a real creature of the night - hard to see and also hard to catch. When this dragon is about to get caught, he spits out a cloud of dense purple smoke and uses it to make his getaway.

items.name: Never Grow Dragon
items.description: His mum always says: "Stop being so childish! Grow up already!", but he just won't. Deus granted him the wish of staying young forever!

items.name: Barebone Dragon
items.description: If your mum always tells you not to play with bad boys, stay away from this dragon. However, if you’re looking for trouble, he will gladly become your partner in crime.

items.name: Yôkai Dragon
items.description: Fighting a dragon is scary. Fighting a dragon and its ghostly double? Absolutely terrifying!

items.name: Ranger Dragon
items.description: The dreaded Sack Man is actually a dragon. Who would've known? If you're a bad kid, this sneaky creature will crawl into your room in the middle of the night to take you away with him forever!

items.name: Bloody Dragon
items.description: This dragon lives alone by a lake. He drowned in it long ago, but now he's alive again and he's furious that no one saved him. He will kill anyone who comes into his territory.

items.name: Bushido Dragon
items.description: The violent existence of this samurai is tempered by wisdom and serenity. Honor, courage and respect are three indispensable values for him.

items.name: La Muerta Dragon
items.description: Her real name is Catrina, but she is mostly known as "La Muerta" because the Day of the Dead is the most important time of the year for her. Honor your dead if you want life to be good to you!

items.name: Crest Dragon
items.description: His hair’s his crowning glory. He grooms it carefully to make sure all of it stands straight up. All the ladies just love that punk touch!

items.name: Bonfire Dragon
items.description: Wood is supposed to burn to ashes when it’s on fire so… why doesn’t this wooden dragon burn to the ground? It’s magic!

items.name: Snail Dragon
items.description: He’s slow but steady. In spite of being called “slug” by many disrespectful creatures, the Snail Dragon has the most positive, can-do attitude.

items.name: Mantis Dragon
items.description: Why Deus decided it was a good idea to breed a Plant Dragon with a common mantis, no one knows… But the result is a happy creature who likes to help all the dragons that live in gardens!

items.name: Sand Dragon
items.description: If you want to find this dragon, you don’t need to look for it, you just need to follow the sand trace it leaves behind. It is a bit clumsy but everybody loves it.

items.name: Bohemian Dragon
items.description: The Bohemian Dragon lives inside a tree in her habitat, where she plays her music and writes her novels. She's not very sociable, but when you get to know her, she's really nice.

items.name: Dual Dragon
items.description: Two personalities, two ways of seeing the world. This dragon’s good side is very nice but also a bit insecure, so it lets the bad, confident side speak for the both of them.

items.name: Old General Dragon
items.description: This dragon is here to command you and not the other way round. All the medals that adorn his jacket are enough to prove that he’s worthy of being in charge of any dragon team.

items.name: Demigod Dragon
items.description: Entire cities have fallen at his feet. In the Middle Age, this dragon was feared but also worshipped, because whoever he favored in a war would win. Bring him to your team and he will make you king.

items.name: Turkey Dragon
items.description: The most important thing you need to know is that Turkey Dragons are not edible. We repeat: Not edible! A man ate a roast Turkey Dragon once and it killed him from inside his stomach.

items.name: Rocket Dragon
items.description: Pure cybernetic fury. This dragon was designed by human minds but they made it so perfect that it became self-sufficient and flew away from them to come to Dragon City.

items.name: Candy Boot Dragon
items.description: This funny dragon loves candy. Once, he came across a boot full of it so he decided to spend his entire life inside it! He doesn’t even mind that there’s only one boot: He just jumps to move!

items.name: Bark Dragon
items.description: This dragon is the perfect example of integration with nature. Its skin is made entirely of bark and instead of blood, sap runs through its veins.

items.name: Fate Dragon
items.description: The ritual he follows for his predictions is quite impressive: He covers his eyes with his stole and lets the words flow. He’s so mystical that it is hard to decipher what he says.

items.name: Voltage Dragon
items.description: This dragon's habitat is a high-risk area, mainly on stormy days. He's dangerous to have around even for Deus - he makes his hair stand up. High voltage!

items.name: Water Storm Dragon
items.description: You think you’ve seen a wave but when it rises up to the sky and you realize it’s the Water Storm Dragon, it’s too late to run - you are overcome by a furious storm.

items.name: Wisp Dragon
items.description: This beautiful dragon arrives quietly, but when it leaves, you know it’s been around because it leaves a trail of refreshing mist.

items.name: Doctor Dragon
items.description: Before you even ask, the answer is yes: Dragon doctors write just as badly as human ones; apart from that, they're really helpful after Tournaments and League battles.

items.name: Grinchy Dragon
items.description: This creature absolutely loathes Christmas and everything related to it, so every year, he tries to ruin the holidays for everyone. Sometimes he even succeeds. He’s great at making family members fight each other.

items.name: Yeti Dragon
items.description: Everyone fears this dragon, so he’s used to a lonely existence. He doesn’t know how to socialize or make friends but the truth is that, under all that greyish fur, there’s a warm heart.

items.name: Avalon Dragon
items.description: This creature is like the personal guard to the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse: he ensures that Conquest, War, Famine and Death are spread all across the world. Owning him assures victory even against the horsemen.

items.name: Wolfreeze Dragon
items.description: This dragon can be found in the most arid parts of Antarctica. He enjoys the isolation and will attack anyone who comes close to his territory just to keep it that way.

items.name: Solstice Dragon
items.description: This dragon can only be found on the longest night of the year, when the Winter Solstice takes place, so if you find one, persuade it to come with you! You’ll only get one opportunity a year!

items.name: The Good Dragon
items.description: The Good Dragon can change the world with his kindness. If you need a helping hand, the Good Dragon will aid you. If you need to win a battle, the Good Dragon will win it for you.

items.name: WinterPhoenix Dragon
items.description: Every year around January, this dragon freezes and turns into an ice statue. After a certain amount of time has passed, he is then reborn with increased strength.

items.name: Firewolf Dragon
items.description: For most dragons it would be a nightmare to live anywhere near the sun, but this one has actually built a house on the sun itself. His home has one of the best views in the entire universe.

items.name: Ignition Dragon
items.description: A swipe from the Ignition Dragon is a hard one to recover from. This creature’s claws are made out of sharp metal but what makes them lethal is that they can also burn. Just thinking about them can hurt your skin.

items.name: Nightmare Dragon
items.description: Deus once had a nightmare that seemed so real his imagination merged with his power and this dragon was created.

items.name: Meditation Dragon
items.description: He spends most of the time in trance. He seems harmless, but the truth is that meditation helps him to have spectacular control over his powers.

items.name: Asian Dragon
items.description: As the guardian of all ancient traditions and an expert in martial arts, she is treated with the highest respect and admiration in her homeland. Be wary of her darts!

items.name: Sunrise Dragon
items.description: It is said that this dragon carries the sun on its back. The truth, however, is that the ball of light that orbits it is just a sphere so dazzling that it can be easily mistaken for our closest star.

items.name: Otoroshi Dragon
items.description: A crawling demon is a creepy thing, but a crawling demon dragon is creepy and dangerous! Be alert when you're walking, as treading on an Otoroshi Dragon would be fatal!

items.name: Nobunaga Dragon
items.description: With his supreme battle skills, two arms would be more than enough for this dragon - but he has four...and two swords, making him all but invincible!

items.name: Super Bowl Dragon
items.description: The Super Bowl Dragon is a sports superstar. He used to be a team mascot, but he learned so much from watching the game that one day he started playing for his team... and he's awesome!

items.name: Red Asian Dragon
items.description: This dragon is especially revered in Asia, where it is said that it has control over rainfall, typhoons and floods. To keep it happy, all kinds of festivals are held in its honor.

items.name: Dancing Dragon
items.description: She’s the most famous dragon in Barbados. The Umbrella Dragon is beautiful but fierce. Try not to upset her because she always speaks her mind!

items.name: Diva Dragon
items.description: This dragon has a talent for constantly changing her looks, to the bewilderment of her adversaries. She has worn all kinds of things, from an antenna on her head to a meat dress. She'll always surprise you!

items.name: Vain Dragon
items.description: He became famous by making videos of himself and posting them on DragonTube. He was hugely successful so he started making records. He has changed a lot - he's a bad boy these days - but his fans still love him.

items.name: Demolition Dragon
items.description: She began as the star of Dragon City Teen TV. She was absolutely angelic, but, as she grew up, she started hanging around with a bad crowd of dragons. Now she should be feared!

items.name: Enigmatic Dragon
items.description: For centuries, kings from all over the world have traveled to Dragon City to try to steal a few of the Enigmatical Dragon’s crystals for their crowns but they end up bowing down before him and begging for his protection.

items.name: Forest Lord Dragon
items.description: 48 football fields worth of forest are lost to deforestation every minute. The Forest Lord Dragon is helping protect the Earth from that destruction. Will you help him save his home?

items.name: Leaf Dragon
items.description: The largest land mammal on Earth, the African elephant, weighs up to eight tons. The Leaf Dragon, on the other hand, is one of the lightest creatures and it can even be moved by the wind.

items.name: Padron Dragon
items.description: One of the biggest threats to biodiversity and ecosystems is where and how we produce food. The Padron Dragon is here to alert the world about this!

items.name: Symbiotic Dragon
items.description: Fresh water provides water for drinking, sanitation, agriculture, transport, electricity generation and recreation. It is also a major habitat for species such as the Symbiotic Dragon.

items.name: Deep Sea Dragon
items.description: Oceans contain the greatest diversity of life on the planet, from microscopic plankton to blue whales and the Deep Sea Dragon, who loves to go for a swim and admire the species that surround him.

items.name: Sustainable Dragon
items.description: By making small changes in the way we eat or use energy, we can begin to ease the pressure on our natural resources. This is the message that the Sustainable Dragon wants to convey.

items.name: Super Flame Dragon
items.description: Do you remember the sweet little Flame Dragon? Well, this is his new look. He has changed a lot and become stronger, and now he likes to go by the name of Super Flame Dragon.

items.name: Super Terra Dragon
items.description: The Terra Dragon has always been very strong, but now that he’s three years old, he has become a Super Terra Dragon! If you try to touch him, we can't guarantee your safety.

items.name: Third Birthday Dragon
items.description: This dragon used to live in a park in Barcelona, but when he heard there was going to be a birthday event in Dragon City he said: "A dragon party? I've got to see this!". So here he is!

items.name: Super Star Dragon
items.description: Our most iconic dragon turns three! To celebrate her birthday, she has changed her look to become more than a star… a Super Star!

items.name: Super Nature Dragon
items.description: Someone must have watered the Nature Dragon with lots of vitamins, because it has grown into this! The Super Nature Dragon is the greenest and most energetic dragon there is.

items.name: Tiamat Dragon
items.description: Three heads, three personalities. The fire head is always furious and wanting to fight, the electric head loves to shock everyone and the head in the middle just wants a normal life, but with the other two, it’s impossible.

items.name: Macha Dragon
items.description: This friendly dragon is said to bring luck to her habitat-mates, so everyone in Dragon City is always inviting her to live at their habitat!

items.name: Squid Dragon
items.description: The Squid Dragon is the captain of the Ghost Ship. His duty is to carry the souls of those who perished in the sea from this world to the next.

items.name: Kraken Dragon
items.description: Pirates claim to be free souls that obey no rules, but they are secretly ruled by the Kraken Dragon, a giant creature who can sink all their ships and riches in seconds if they don’t accept his rule.

items.name: Captain Dragon
items.description: The dragon pirate ship is a crazy place, especially when the Captain Dragon is around. He loves having his crew fight each other just for his entertainment. All he needs to say is “Show time!”, and the battles start.

items.name: Dark Pearl Dragon
items.description: Some sailors say that their ships were sunk by what looked like a regular pirate ship from the surface. As it got closer, however, they could see that it was actually a dragon wearing a ship! Now you know that their stories were true.

items.name: Highborn Dragon
items.description: This noble dragon commands an army of eagles that watches over the entire dragon world. He takes a lot of pride in his duty!

items.name: Joke Dragon
items.description: What sound do you hear when dragons eat spicy salsa? The fire alarm!

items.name: Nessy Dragon
items.description: The Nessy Dragon gets bored if you keep him in his habitat all the time. He's such a fast swimmer, and all he wants to do is show off in front of his rivals. He also loves a good battle!

items.name: Magma Dragon
items.description: A mother dragon was flying over a volcano, when the egg she was carrying slipped through her claws. She thought she'd lost her son forever, but she hadn't—her baby rose from the crater wrapped in magma, unstoppable.

items.name: Ard Rí Dragon
items.description: This spirit of the forest was transformed into a dragon by Mother Nature so that he could fulfill a duty: to protect the High Kings of Ireland for eternity.

items.name: FrozeBeast Dragon
items.description: Some mischievous souls love the heat, so hell could be a nice place for them. To make sure they don’t have too much fun, they’re sent to the cold branch of hell, where they are monitored by FrozeBeast.

items.name: Zodiac Aries Dragon
items.description: Aries is one of the Zodiac Dragons who give their names to our constellations. He was born under the influence of Mars, which made him proud stubborn and honest.

items.name: Ozone Dragon
items.description: This dragon is essential for the ecosystem of Dragon City! She keeps the air clean and protects the islands whenever the Sun Dragon shines a bit too much.

items.name: High Fenrir Dragon
items.description: Heroic Dragons evolve to their young stage at level 10 and become adults at level 20. The High Fenrir Dragon belongs to unique caste: The Heroic Dragons. He is a celestial palatine who protects the norse gods. He’s actually considered a demigod.

items.name: Glitter Dragon
items.description: All that glitters here is gold. This dragon had a decisive role in Dragon War I, so the king of his country had a gold suit of armor made for him so that everyone would know that he was a golden warrior.

items.name: Intraterrestrial Dragon
items.description: The Intraterrestrial Dragon is one of the very few creatures that can survive on every layer of the Earth. Having spent most of his life investigating on his own has made him weird among the weird, as you can see.

items.name: Firefrog Dragon
items.description: This dragon comes from the Earth’s inner core and, as you can see, creatures are a bit different there! The Firefrog Dragon is a rare and fascinating beast that will look great in your collection.

items.name: Choleric Dragon
items.description: This is the dragon version of an armored tank: Tough and steady, only more dangerous. Be careful with his spiky tail!

items.name: Reaper Dragon
items.description: Many have seen the Reaper Dragon, but none of them have been able to tell us how it is, because the moment they saw the Reaper Dragon walk towards them, they knew their time had come.

items.name: Bear Dragon
items.description: The Bear Dragon hibernates for 7 months every year, so he can be seen as lazy, but when he’s active, his strength and resistance make him a great partner in battle.

items.name: Panther Dragon
items.description: Panther Dragons are extremely rare and not many have seen one, but those who have describe these creatures as quick and strong. It is also known that they are stealthy hunters!

items.name: Snake Dragon
items.description: This is quite a particular snake. Unlike the rest of his kind, he’s not very cunning. All he does is insult other jungle animals and hide behind the protection of stronger allies.

items.name: Tiger Dragon
items.description: This feline dragon is one of the most respected creatures in the jungle. Regular tigers are very intelligent, have a great memory and are very quick, but this one is all that be it can also fly!

items.name: Dark Sky Dragon
items.description: This dragon, also known as "King of the Night", reigns whenever the sun is not shining. He can control all creatures of the dark just by looking at them.

items.name: High Nucleus Dragon
items.description: Heroic Dragons evolve to their young stage at level 10 and become adults at level 20. This is a creature made of gravity, heat and rocks. He belongs to the unique lineage of Heroic Dragons. If he treads on you, you will end in the center of the Earth!

items.name: Sunlight Dragon
items.description: Sunlight Dragon’s skin has special light-absorbing cells which allow him to store lots of sunrays and shine brightly when the sun is gone. He’s also nice to have around when it’s cold… So warm!

items.name: Banana Dragon
items.description: The Banana Dragon looks harmless, but he’s actually really dangerous! He can attack you in all sorts of ways: his deadliest strategy is leaving his skin on the floor so that you slip and fall!

items.name: Wacky Dragon
items.description: The Wacky Dragon used to be very serious but one day an attack he performed went wrong and, instead of hitting his opponent, it hit him. He went mad but now he's pretty funny.

items.name: Holi Dragon
items.description: The Holi Dragon symbolizes the victory of good over evil. It has a very nice attitude towards life: play and laugh, forget and forgive. Celebrate the good things that happen!

items.name: Timetravel Dragon
items.description: One of the most brilliant creations of the Dragon City labs. Magic, science and technology have come together: This dragon can go back and forth in time!

items.name: Vanoss Dragon
items.description: The Vanoss Dragon likes games, darts, hanging out with his friends and, above all… Knawledge. He also has a signature joke: “What do you call a magic owl? Hoodini!”

items.name: Crazy Dragon
items.description: His name is Delirious, and he’s real serious. They call him mysterious, ‘cause he leaves you real curious. His name is Delirious… won’t you like his videos?

items.name: High Tension Dragon
items.description: Heroic Dragons evolve to their young stage at level 10 and become adults at level 20. Don't take the High Tension Dragon for just another bad boy, he's truly dangerous. There are a lot of rumors about him but nobody dares to ask for fear that those deadly rumors are confirmed.

items.name: Glowppy Dragon
items.description: On a joyful summer night, fireworks lit up the sky. A spark reached a baby dragon and set his wings on fire. That fire never went out! Glowppy brings good feelings to everyone around him.

items.name: Dark Ash Dragon
items.description: Never relax after putting out a fire, for a Dark Ash Dragon could arise from the ashes at any moment! The toxic fumes that this creature emits when it flies are seriously dangerous!

items.name: Caribbean Dragon
items.description: This dragon lives by the coral reefs of the Caribbean Sea. He shares his space with thousands of tropical fish. He’s friendly to all sea creatures, but sometimes he does enjoy a grilled crab or two.

items.name: Drainbow Dragon
items.description: This dragon was born under the rainbow of the Rainbow Island, right here in Dragon City! Being a Dragon City native, not only does he have the protection of Deus, but also the support of Speedy & Greedy, the resource guardians.

items.name: Discus Thrower Dragon
items.description: This impressive creature can chop down acres of trees with one throw of his discus. Imagine what he can do to a mere dragon!

items.name: Archer Dragon
items.description: A technological twist to traditional archery: This dragon can produce laser arrows on his back and then shoot them with his tail. He never runs out of them!

items.name: Runner Dragon
items.description: This guy is as fast as a dragon can get: He can travel across all of Dragon City in less than a minute! He loves a good competition even though nobody can really compete at his level.

items.name: Fencing Dragon
items.description: The Fencing Dragon is steady but agile. When you see him approaching you with caution, you would never imagine that he can swing his sword and defeat you in seconds. Be on guard!

items.name: High Guardian Dragon
items.description: High Guardian Dragon This creature isn’t made of flesh & bone, but of circuits & steel. The High Guardian Dragon is equipped with the best security technology, so you can leave your most precious belongings with him: He will keep them safe.

items.name: Liquid Dragon
items.description: This creature is flexible and resistant, but don't keep him too close to the Sun Dragon if you don't want him to dry up! "Be liquid, my friend."

items.name: Dragasand Dragon
items.description: Dragasand is a truly resistant creature. Don't be afraid to send him on the hardest survival missions, because he can go through the desert for months and make it to the other side without a drop of water.

items.name: Friendship Dragon
items.description: This dragon really is the best friend you could have. When you’re sad, he will lift up your spirit and when you’re happy, he’ll be happy too! If you don’t believe us, just look at his little yellow friend, who’s held on to him for years!

items.name: AirBoss Dragon
items.description: The Airboss Dragon has taken flying to the next level. He designed his own wings, that allow him to go faster and further than anyone else. The boss of the sky has landed on Dragon City!

items.name: Rune Dragon
items.description: History holds secrets from us, secrets that very few people and creatures know. The answers to these are written all over the Rune Dragon's body, but to discover them, you'll have to master him and learn to read the signs.

items.name: Brainy Dragon
items.description: The Brainy Dragon may be tiny, but his plans are big! His sole intelligence will be enough to rule the entire universe, so join his galactic army or be ready to suffer!

items.name: Martian Dragon
items.description: If you had never seen a dragon from Mars, now you have! Martian Dragons are smart and friendly but sometimes they have trouble understanding earthly habits, so try to be patient with them.

items.name: Space Being Dragon
items.description: This dragon is a space diplomat: She builds communication bridges between dragons of different planets and cultures so she really likes Dragon City, where hundreds of different creatures live together in harmony!

items.name: Alien Pet Dragon
items.description: Alien Pets are a must in all UFOs. They are loyal to Martian Dragons, even though they can be a bit naughty and tend to bite wires when they spend too much time inside their spaceships.

items.name: Hero Dragon
items.description: With a noble heart and a sword forged with bravery, the Hero Dragon has arrived to impose justice upon Dragon City.

items.name: Hell Twin Dragon
items.description: These two should have been separated at birth because, as they share one body, it is double danger! The right head has demonic plans, while the left one destroys everything impulsively!

items.name: Froyo Dragon
items.description: He is creamy and he looks delicious, but do your best to resist the temptation: If you try to steal a scoop of his flesh, you will suffer the consequences.

items.name: Free Spirit Dragon
items.description: Music festivals, surfing and skating - that is what the Free Spirit Dragon is all about. You only live once, so why would you waste your precious time stressing out?

items.name: Draost Dragon
items.description: He was personally trained by Hanzo, the Guardian Dragon, to become a great warrior. In return, Draost swore eternal loyalty and service to him.

items.name: High Priest Dragon
items.description: The High Priest Dragon can control pure energy like no one else. In his ceremonies, energy empowers him so much that it makes him levitate. When he’s in trance, he becomes untouchable.

items.name: Unicorn Dragon
items.description: Just like a rainbow! This creature has magical properties that can cure lots of illnesses that no other treatment can. It also smells like cotton candy.

items.name: City Shark Dragon
items.description: An infamously bad-tempered shark with a reputation for trouble, "The Sharko", as he likes to be called, is known to spark conflict wherever he goes. This is one dragon you don't want to start a bar fight with!

items.name: Roller Coaster Dragon
items.description: Fun is guaranteed whenever the Roller Coaster Dragon comes to town. If you’re looking for a thrill, all you need to do is sit on his back and hold tight!

items.name: Big Wheel Dragon
items.description: Everyone loves going for a ride on this dragon’s wheel, since it offers the best views of Dragon City. The problem is that, sometimes he gets angry for no particular reason and starts spinning his wheel furiously, making all the passengers dizzy.

items.name: Rideable Dragon
items.description: He used to be part of a carousel, but he hated that life, going around in circles all day, every day. One day he decided to escape and became a free dragon!

items.name: Terrifying Dragon
items.description: In for a ride? Hop on the Terrifying Dragon only if you aren’t afraid of fire, velocity and the high probability of being devoured by one of its heads.

items.name: Night Dragon
items.description: The Night Dragon not only provokes fear, but also disgust. He’s like a giant bat and he can always be found lurking in dark, dusty corners.

items.name: Wolfish Dragon
items.description: Wolffish Dragons are the official guards of the Lord of the Seas. They are loyal to their master and they will mercilessly destroy all his enemies.

items.name: White Soul Dragon
items.description: The White Soul Dragon has descended from a world above to illuminate the way of lost souls and save them from going the way of evil.

items.name: Toad Dragon
items.description: You can find the Toad Dragon at nightfall bouncing from stone to stone. You won’t get much conversation out of him, since he is unsocial and bad-tempered. He tends to play dead when approached by fearsome dragons.

items.name: Nightglow Dragon
items.description: Nothing glows in the dark like fire. Use this creature to lead your dragon army through the dark and, not only will he do that: He will also be the first one to defend his master.

items.name: High Tidal Dragon
items.description: Heroic Dragons evolve to their young stage at level 10 and become adults at level 20. The High Tidal Dragon can control the tides from the seafloor. That is how powerful he is! He can also shift sea currents and summon white whales.

items.name: Goblin Dragon
items.description: The Goblin Dragon is obsessed with stealing all the pumpkins he can find from everyone’s yards, so Halloween is the time of the year he loves the most, of course.

items.name: Hercules Dragon
items.description: The Hercules Dragon is one of the Star Warrior Dragons! He is brave and unstoppable in battle. Where others see enemies, he only sees cockroaches he can easily defeat.

items.name: Moonlight Dragon
items.description: Dragons are more sensitive to moonlight than other creatures. This one in particular spent a whole night of full moon staring at the sky and was possessed by it. Now he directs the moon’s energy onto Dragon City.

items.name: Dracula Dragon
items.description: The king of the underworld doesn’t like to be upstaged. If you are to try to steal the Throne of Bats from him, know that you’ll most probably fail and suspiciously disappear forever.

items.name: Vampiress Dragon
items.description: Antonya was an out-of-control dragon who used to destroy entire cities in Romania, but when she was about to vent her fury upon Transylvania, the Dracula Dragon made her a vampiress. Now she is cold-blooded and calm, but more evil than ever.

items.name: Werewolf Dragon
items.description: On every night of full moon, this dragon needs to be chained down and watched by several guards. If he broke free, he would be able to destroy the entire Dragon City in a couple of hours.

items.name: Disco Ninja Dragon
items.description: By day, he’s the most serious ninja of them all — an unstoppable assassin, but when the night falls… the only thing he kills is the dance floor!

items.name: Cereal Killer Dragon
items.description: His cereal-based diet can keep this dragon going for battles of battles — and when he’s out of opponents… he just goes and assaults innocent dragons’ habitats.

items.name: Millenial Dragon
items.description: This cool dragon is the result of a collaboration of great youtubers who came together for a good cause in Dragon City, so obviously, Tuber loves technology, video games and jokes!

items.name: High Comet Dragon
items.description: Heroic Dragons evolve to their young stage at level 10 and become adults at level 20. Like a King of the Cosmos, the High Comet Dragon knows every corner of the universe and flies at high speed all through it. It is practically impossible to see this dragon unless he's standing still.

items.name: Poisonous Dragon
items.description: The Poisonous Dragon is a walking danger. He doesn’t even need to attack his enemies to make them turn green and fall flat on the floor. His toxic breath gets the job done!

items.name: Drace Dragon
items.description: This dragon has a special affection for the Ice Island. His armor and sword are entirely devoted to the protection of Broodby, the guardian of quick hatchings.

items.name: Mwahaha Dragon
items.description: His evil laugh is feared throughout the whole Dragon City. The Mwahaha Dragon has a twisted brain and he’s a dirty player, so don’t ever trust him! Oh, and if you hear him laughing… run!

items.name: Dark Cave Dragon
items.description: Dragons used to be persecuted in the region where this dragon comes from, so he hid inside a dark cave for years, he even grew branches and moss on his skin to camouflage himself. Now he’s out and ready to see the world!

items.name: Lightspeed Dragon
items.description: This dragon was born super fast, but when he heard about the speed of light, he thought: “Well, that is how quick I want to be”. His spirit of achievement took him there and now he’s the Light Speed Dragon!

items.name: Massif Dragon
items.description: This lonely creature lives in mountains of Dragon City, away from all the noise and laughter that is always present on the floating islands. Don’t feel sorry for him, that’s the way he likes to live.

items.name: Icewind Dragon
items.description: Dragons used to be persecuted in the region where this dragon comes from, so he hid inside a dark cave for years, he even grew branches and moss on his skin to camouflage himself. Now he’s out and ready to see the world!

items.name: Penumbra Dragon
items.description: This dragon can be found in the dark areas of the jungle, where he reigns over all the animals that live there. To show off his power, the Penumbra Dragon lights up the blue energy he encapsulates within.

items.name: Drathic Dragon
items.description: The tower in the Gothic Island hides secret breeding recipes that only Phaun has access to. This dragon protects all those secrets from curious eyes.

items.name: Patriot General Dragon
items.description: The High Patriot Dragon is made of dreams, courage and steel. He has fought in hundreds of wars defending his country and that is what he’ll keep on doing until his very last day in the world.

items.name: High Realm Dragon
items.description: Heroic Dragons evolve to their young stage at level 10 and become adults at level 20. This is the last dragon standing in the Dark Realm. An army of Light warriors tore the place down years ago, but they could not defeat the High Realm Dragon and gave up.

items.name: Tin Woodman Dragon
items.description: The secret to this solid machine is the warm heart it encapsulates. It beats with a strength that makes the Tin Woodman Dragon unstoppable.

items.name: Scarecrow Dragon
items.description: Crows are not the only ones to get freaked out by this dragon's bad temper. He likes to have his own personal space, but if you want to bug him a little, you can follow the trace of straw to find him.

items.name: Dorothy Dragon
items.description: You never know where the yellow brick road will take you, but if you're willing to find out, grab your ruby slippers and call the Dorothy Dragon. She'll be your partner in adventure!

items.name: Cowardly Dragon
items.description: He had a really tough childhood and everyone used to call him a coward, but one day he built himself those impressive mechanical wings and gained confidence. Now he's a big hero!

items.name: Witch Dragon
items.description: The Witch Dragon will walk into your life offering treats and compliments, but don't trust her! When you least expect, she will show her true self and take everything away from you, including your very soul.

items.name: Royal Phoenix Dragon
items.description: The Royal Phoenix Dragon has loyally served generations of kings as a messenger and bearer of secrets. Some say that he has so much information about wars and kingdoms that he’s more powerful than any of the kings he’s assisted.

items.name: Valentine Dragon
items.description: Valentine loves chocolate, long walks by the sea, starry nights and candlelit dinners. If someone special is there… even better!

items.name: High Entity Dragon
items.description: Heroic Dragons evolve to their young stage at level 10 and become adults at level 20. ...

items.name: Conquest Dragon
items.description: Just when it seemed there was no hope for the dragon race, the Conquest Dragon appeared. This magnificent creature has come to reconquer the world from evil with light and justice.

items.name: Warfare Dragon
items.description: In an apocalyptic world, the Warfare Dragon is still standing. With a legacy of hundreds of kingdoms destroyed, you’ll have to trust him when he says he has no master.

items.name: Hunger Dragon
items.description: When you see this dragon coming, you’ll know the Apocalypse is here. He brings nothing good, only hunger and despair.

items.name: Deathly Dragon
items.description: All dragons know that when this dragon approaches them, their time has come. Deploy him on the battlefield to see how his sole presence makes your enemies shiver.

items.name: Tornado Dragon
items.description: A terrible tornado was destroying Dragon City when a very special master called Sean summoned an incredible force of nature: The Tornado Dragon. With great power and skill, this creature controlled the situation and saved the city. All thanks to Master Sean!

items.name: Kong Dragon
items.description: The Kong Dragon lived on a peaceful island. When a Dragon Master discovered this island, he captured Kong and took him to the big city, where he planned to exhibit him. However, the dragon wreaked havoc across the city and escaped back to his island.

items.name: Geist Dragon
items.description: Once there was an evil dragon defeated by the forces of Light. When he died, his spirit landed on an empty egg. This spirit grew stronger and eventually summoned more dragon spirits. Now it has the power of four dragons and is ready to conquer everything.

items.name: Beauty Dragon
items.description: The Beauty Dragon is very independent. She tends to find herself in trouble, but she doesn’t need anyone to rescue her. There’s no problem she can’t overcome by herself.

items.name: Furious Dragon
items.description: A witch cursed him and condemned him to a long life of loneliness, but in spite of being a lonely creature, the Beast Dragon has a kind heart and is ready to fight love.

items.name: One Horned Dragon
items.description: The Beauty and the Beast Dragons had a child! It’s the Beastling Dragon, a little intrepid creature with the strength of his parents and an adventurous spirit of his own.

items.name: High Supremacy Dragon
items.description: Heroic Dragons evolve to their young stage at level 10 and become adults at level 20. ...

items.name: Freezox Dragon
items.description: A thousand volts surround the golden armor of this powerful dragon. In year 2056, the Voltaix Dragon is one of the top fighters in Dragon City. He has come from the future to learn what he considers ancient techniques.

items.name: Pyrex Dragon
items.description: Space fire, everyone! The Pyrex Dragon is able to set feet on the Sun without getting burnt. He goes there and charges his core with solar fire and comes back to Dragon City supersonically fast!

items.name: Voltaix Dragon
items.description: This futuristic dragon has managed to use ice in a smart yet lethal way. His wings are made out of sharpened stalactites that never melt, because he generates cold that circulates from inside his chest to the rest of his body.

items.name: Poisonux Dragon
items.description: Poison from the future is even more toxic than present poison, and that’s where this dragon comes from!. A spit of poison from the Poisonux Dragon is enough to corrode and destroy entire buildings.

dragons.name: Guardangel, Protector of the Heavens
dragons.description: Guardangel has held the key to the gates of Heaven from time immemorial. He is in charge of an army of loyal protectors who fight for justice and punish the bad dragons.
